pages.content:
By
Sukriti Srivastava
/
MetaDesign Solutions developed an event-based Outlook add-in that automates the dynamic insertion of email signatures based on the recipient's domain, streamlining email communication across web, desktop, and mobile platforms
Overview
MetaDesign Solutions partnered with a solo entrepreneur to develop a signature management add-in for Outlook. The plugin, designed for web, desktop, and mobile versions of Outlook, automates the insertion of email signatures based on events like email composition and recipient changes. With a fully customizable signature management system integrated via API, the add-in offers a seamless solution for managing internal, external, and reply signatures, significantly improving email consistency for users. MetaDesign Solutions successfully delivered a robust and scalable solution tailored to the client’s needs.
about the client
The client, a solo entrepreneur, sought to simplify and streamline the process of email signature management within Outlook. They envisioned a solution where signatures would be automatically applied based on the recipient’s domain, allowing for dynamic adjustments based on the context of internal, external, reply, or forward emails.
This project aimed to serve individuals and businesses alike, providing them with a versatile tool to manage professional email signatures without manual intervention. By using an event-based add-in triggered during key email actions (e.g., composing, sending, and recipient changes), the client was able to offer their end users a streamlined way to handle signature insertion. Additionally, the entrepreneur foresaw the need for users to customize their signatures via a separate web application, a feature that was seamlessly integrated into the plugin.
Industry Domain
Professional Services and Education
Service Category (Service-line)
Outlook Plug-in Development / Office Plug-in Development / Digital Product Development
Technologies Used
Angular
HTML5
CSS3
Office Add-in SDK
Challenges
Cross-Platform Compatibility : Ensuring the plugin functioned seamlessly across Outlook's web, desktop, and mobile versions.
Dynamic Signature Insertion : Automating signature updates based on internal or external email recipients, with flexibility for replies and forwards.
Real-Time API Integration : Fetching signature data in real-time from an external API and embedding it into the email body.
Customizable Signature Management : Allowing users to personalize their signatures via a web application while synchronizing these changes instantly with the Outlook add-in.
Solution Scope and Services
MetaDesign Solutions developed a comprehensive event-based Outlook add-in that automates signature management based on email actions such as composition, recipient changes, and sending. The add-in works by retrieving signature data from an API, enabling the insertion of various signature types (internal, external, reply, forward) based on the recipient's domain.
To further enhance the flexibility and user experience, the add-in was designed to work with a standalone web application, where users could log in and customize their signatures. These customized signatures would then be synchronized with the add-in, ensuring that the right signature was inserted in real-time. The project scope also involved extensive testing to ensure compatibility across web, desktop, and mobile versions of Outlook.
01
Cross-Platform Compatibility in Outlook Add-ins
Developing an add-in that works seamlessly across Outlook’s web, desktop, and mobile versions required robust testing and optimization. MetaDesign Solutions ensured that the plugin functioned smoothly regardless of the platform, enhancing user experience and productivity.
02
Dynamic Signature Management with Event-Triggered Automation
Automating signature insertion based on key events like composing or sending an email was crucial for the project. By utilizing Outlook’s event-based model, the add-in dynamically inserted signatures based on recipient domains, ensuring consistent branding and professionalism.
03
Real-Time Signature Customization via Web Integration
The web application component allowed users to fully customize their email signatures, which would then sync with the add-in in real-time. This integration provided flexibility while maintaining the automation and consistency of the plugin's core functionality.
Results
The Outlook Signature Event-Based Add-in delivered by MetaDesign Solutions provided the solo entrepreneur with an effective and scalable solution for managing email signatures. The automation of signature insertion based on recipient domain significantly reduced manual intervention, saving time and improving consistency across email communications. The plugin’s integration with an external API and the accompanying web application for real-time customization offered end users a highly flexible and efficient tool for managing their professional email signatures.
By addressing key challenges such as cross-platform compatibility and dynamic signature retrieval, the project has made a tangible impact on the client's ability to offer a streamlined email communication tool to their customers. MetaDesign Solutions’ expertise ensured a successful implementation that met all the client’s business needs.

headings.text: Streamlining tariff approval processes for Medanta hospital using a custom NoCode platform
Leveraging NodeJS and PostgreSQL for Backend Efficiency

pages.content:
By
Sukriti Srivastava
/
Streamlining tariff approval processes for Medanta hospital using a custom NoCode platform
Overview
MetaDesign Solutions partnered with Medanta Hospital to develop a tailored Tariff Approval Process using their proprietary NoCode platform, CodeNula. The platform automated the previously manual, email-driven process of managing tariff requests, making it more efficient and transparent. The solution, powered by NodeJS, ReactJS, and PostgreSQL, was securely hosted in Medanta’s in-house data center. The deployment of this system significantly improved request tracking, approvals, and reporting, addressing the hospital's need for a streamlined internal workflow.
about the client
Medanta Hospital, also known as Medanta – The Medicity, is one of India’s largest multi-specialty healthcare providers. Founded in 2009 by Dr. Naresh Trehan, a globally renowned cardiovascular surgeon, Medanta has consistently ranked among the top hospitals in India, serving patients across several cities including Gurugram, Lucknow, Patna, and Ranchi. It is known for offering world-class healthcare services that combine cutting-edge medical technologies with affordable care.
As a leading healthcare institution, Medanta specializes in a wide array of medical disciplines, ranging from cardiology to oncology and neurology. With a strong commitment to research, innovation, and patient-centric care, Medanta attracts both national and international patients. The hospital’s infrastructure is equipped to handle complex surgeries and treatments, contributing to its global reputation as a top healthcare destination.
Industry Domain
Healthcare
Service Category (Service-line)
No Code / Low Code Development
Technologies Used
CodeNula
NodeJS
ReactJS
PostgresQL
Challenges
Manual Process : The previous tariff approval process was managed via email, which led to delays and inefficiencies.
Lack of Transparency : There was no system in place to track requests, leading to confusion and delays in processing.
Security Concerns : Sensitive tariff data needed to be securely managed within the hospital’s internal network.
Scalability : The platform needed to serve multiple units and users across various hospital locations.
Role-Based Access : Ensuring that only authorized personnel could access, approve, and modify tariffs was crucial.
Solution Scope and Services
MetaDesign Solutions developed a comprehensive Tariff Approval Process platform that addressed Medanta’s need for an automated and secure system. Using CodeNula, MetaDesign delivered a user-friendly, web-based solution that allowed authorized employees to request new tariffs or modify existing ones. The system supported multi-level approvals, where RA Cell members could approve, reject, or seek clarification on requests. Approved requests were then processed by the IT team, who could update the status of each request until completion.
This platform was powered by NodeJS for backend operations, ReactJS for a seamless user interface, and PostgreSQL for efficient data management. It was designed to securely operate within Medanta’s in-house data center, ensuring data privacy and compliance with their internal IT policies. The system also provided comprehensive reporting features, allowing administrators to generate reports and track the lifecycle of each request.
01
Empowering Users with NoCode Automation
The use of CodeNula allowed Medanta to rapidly deploy the tariff approval system without the need for extensive coding. This approach not only sped up the development process but also provided a customizable platform for future modifications. By empowering Medanta’s internal teams with a NoCode solution, MetaDesign delivered a scalable system that could easily evolve as the hospital’s needs changed.
02
Leveraging NodeJS and PostgreSQL for Backend Efficiency
Choosing a NodeJS and PostgreSQL stack ensured that the application was fast, efficient, and capable of handling multiple tariff requests simultaneously. NodeJS, known for its asynchronous event-driven architecture, provided a responsive backend, while PostgreSQL offered robust data management, ensuring that all tariff requests were securely stored and easily accessible for reporting purposes.
03
Enhancing Security with In-House Hosting
Given the sensitivity of healthcare data, MetaDesign Solutions ensured that the application was securely hosted in Medanta’s in-house data center. This setup not only met the hospital’s stringent security requirements but also provided full control over data access and protection. The platform was integrated with Active Directory (AD), ensuring only authorized personnel could access the system.
Results
The Tariff Approval Process solution developed by MetaDesign Solutions revolutionized how Medanta Hospital managed tariff requests. The automation of this critical process reduced delays, improved transparency, and enhanced overall operational efficiency. By leveraging MetaDesign’s in-house NoCode platform, CodeNula, alongside modern technologies like NodeJS and ReactJS, Medanta was able to implement a scalable, secure, and reliable solution tailored to its specific needs. This project not only streamlined internal workflows but also contributed to Medanta’s broader mission of providing high-quality, affordable healthcare.

Leveraging ReactJS for an Intuitive User Experience

pages.content:
By
Sukriti Srivastava
/
Empowering Medanta hospital with a customizable purchase request workflow system for streamlined operations
Overview
MetaDesign Solutions partnered with Medanta Hospital to develop a custom business workflow platform that enables seamless purchase request approvals across multiple departments. Using MetaDesign Solutions' proprietary No-Code Platform, CodeNula , the solution was tailored to fit Medanta's complex hierarchy-based approval system and strict organizational procedures. Additionally, the workflow includes auto-escalation features to ensure timely approvals. Deployed on Medanta’s in-house servers, the solution enables efficient communication and enhances overall operational efficiency.
about the client
Medanta Hospital, founded by Dr. Naresh Trehan, is one of India’s largest multi-specialty tertiary care hospitals. With multiple branches across major cities, Medanta is renowned for its world-class medical facilities and expert doctors trained from globally reputed institutions. Over the past four years, Medanta Gurugram has consistently ranked as the top private hospital in India and has also been recognized as one of the top 250 hospitals globally by Newsweek in 2023.
Medanta follows a patient-first approach, integrating collaboration and multi-specialty care across its network. Their highly qualified team of specialists offers advanced care in fields such as cardiology, oncology, orthopedics, and more. To support their high standards, Medanta requires robust internal systems, including streamlined workflows that improve the efficiency of their operational processes, which is where MetaDesign Solutions stepped in to assist with their purchasing workflows.
Industry Domain
Healthcare
Service Category (Service-line)
No Code / Low Code Development
Technologies Used
CodeNula
NodeJS
ReactJS
PostgresQL
Challenges
Configurable Approval Workflows : Medanta needed a system to manage complex, hierarchical purchase approvals across multiple departments, requiring configurable rules based on department roles and purchase values.
Cross-Department Transfers : The solution needed to handle requests transferred between departments while preserving the approval history and roles.
Clarification Loop : Enabling a request to move back and forth between hierarchies for clarifications before final approval.
Escalation Mechanism : Implementing auto-escalation to handle unapproved requests within the set timeframe, minimizing delays.
Integration into Medanta’s Infrastructure : Ensuring the solution was compatible with Medanta’s existing systems and deployed securely on their in-house servers.
Solution Scope and Services
MetaDesign Solutions developed an advanced purchase request workflow system for Medanta using its No-Code platform, CodeNula , integrated with ReactJS for the front end, NodeJS for the backend , and PostgreSQL for database management . The system was designed to be fully configurable, allowing Medanta’s internal administrators to define complex approval hierarchies and rules, customize role-based workflows, and manage departmental transfers efficiently.
A key feature of the platform is its auto-escalation system, which notifies users via email if a request isn’t processed within a set timeframe. The request is then automatically reassigned if further delays occur. The solution ensures that purchase requests are handled seamlessly, with built-in flexibility for back-and-forth clarification within departments and across hierarchical levels.
01
Cross-Department Collaboration through Workflow Automation
The solution developed by MetaDesign Solutions allowed for seamless cross-departmental collaboration by integrating role-based approvals and transfer capabilities. This enabled Medanta's various departments to interact and approve purchase requests without manual delays, promoting smoother interdepartmental communication.
02
Implementing Auto-Escalation for Timely Approvals
The built-in auto-escalation feature ensures that if an assigned approver does not act within a stipulated timeframe, the request is automatically escalated to the next available authority. This mechanism significantly reduced the approval bottlenecks and enhanced the speed of purchase approvals across the hospital.
03
Leveraging ReactJS for an Intuitive User Experience
MetaDesign Solutions chose ReactJS to power the frontend of the purchase request platform, offering a seamless and intuitive interface. Users across various departments and roles can interact with the platform effortlessly, leading to faster adoption and higher efficiency in handling purchase requests.
Results
MetaDesign Solutions successfully delivered a customized purchase request workflow system that significantly enhanced Medanta Hospital’s operational efficiency. By automating manual approval processes and providing an intuitive interface built on ReactJS , the solution allows Medanta’s teams to approve, transfer, and escalate requests in real-time, ensuring prompt decision-making.
With the implementation of CodeNula , Medanta now has full control over configuring workflows to align with changing operational needs. The inclusion of an auto-escalation feature further ensures that purchase requests are never delayed, improving the hospital’s procurement process. This digital transformation has empowered Medanta to streamline administrative operations, allowing them to focus more on delivering quality healthcare.

headings.text: Revolutionizing video content management in healthcare with AI: an end-to-end solution for efficient organization, enhanced accessibility, and scalable technology integration
Optimizing the Use of LLM Models

pages.content:
By
Sukriti Srivastava
/
Revolutionizing video content management in healthcare with AI: an end-to-end solution for efficient organization, enhanced accessibility, and scalable technology integration
Overview
MetaDesign Solutions successfully developed a comprehensive AI-powered content summarization and cataloging platform for a leading healthcare learning services firm. The solution efficiently manages terabytes of video data, generating summaries, captions, trailers, and chapter breakdowns. It also includes a web-based digital product that offers secure, multilingual access to curated content, significantly enhancing user experience and operational efficiency.
about the client
The Client, a prominent player in the healthcare learning services sector, is dedicated to curating, producing, and delivering high-quality educational content for healthcare professionals. Their operations span across multiple facets of the healthcare education landscape, including the organization of large-scale events that generate vast amounts of video content. These events feature lectures and discussions that are invaluable resources for professionals in the field. Over the years, the Client has accumulated terabytes of video content, which serves as a critical component of their educational offerings.
In addition to event coverage, the Client also produces and curates a wide range of learning materials, making them accessible to their audience through various digital platforms. These platforms are designed to be technologically advanced, enabling seamless interaction and engagement for users. The Client's commitment to leveraging technology is evident in their approach to content delivery, where they employ state-of-the-art digital products to enhance the learning experience for healthcare professionals globally. Their need for an efficient, scalable solution to manage and organize their extensive video archive led to the collaboration with MetaDesign Solutions.
Industry Domain
Allied Healthcare, Education
Service Category (Service-line)
AI Engineering / LLM / Digital Product Development
Technologies Used
Google Gemini
OpenAI
Python
React
AWS
Challenges
Efficient Management and Organization of Large Video Archives : Handling terabytes of video content required a robust solution that could effectively catalog and organize this vast data set.
Enhanced Accessibility and User Experience : Ensuring that users could easily navigate, search, and consume content required intuitive design and functionality.
Multilingual Support and Accessibility : The platform needed to cater to a global audience, necessitating the inclusion of transcription and translation services.
Scalability and Technological Integration : Integrating the solution with existing systems while ensuring it could scale with growing content volumes was crucial.
Automation and Error Handling : Automating the content processing pipeline without compromising accuracy was a significant challenge, especially given the need for reliable error handling and self-correction mechanisms.
Solution Scope and Services
The project scope encompassed the development of an AI-driven tool designed to manage, organize, and enhance video content. MetaDesign Solutions employed cutting-edge technologies, including Google AI Gemini Models, OpenAI's GPT LLM Model, and AssemblyAI, to create a tool that could analyze video content and generate a wide array of metadata. This metadata included summaries, captions, trailers, chapter divisions, and tags, all of which were crucial for making the content more accessible and easier to navigate.
Additionally, a web-based digital product was developed to allow users to access this enriched content. The platform was designed with a user-friendly interface, providing secure login options and advanced search functionalities that utilized the generated metadata. The platform's responsive design ensured seamless access across devices, enhancing the overall user experience. MetaDesign Solutions' comprehensive approach addressed the Client's challenges, offering a scalable, efficient, and user-centric solution.
01
Optimizing the Use of LLM Models
MetaDesign Solutions strategically employed a combination of Google Gemini LLM Models and OpenAI's GPT models to optimize the cost of video cataloging. By deploying less expensive models for tasks that did not require high computational power and reserving the more advanced models for complex tasks, the solution maintained high efficiency without incurring unnecessary expenses. This approach ensured that the Client could manage their vast video content without compromising on quality or performance.
02
Building a Chain for Automation
The integration of various web components in the chain of tasks-based application posed unique challenges, particularly in maintaining smooth performance transitions and functional parity. MetaDesign Solutions tackled these by implementing advanced coding practices and optimization techniques, ensuring that the application could host web components effectively without hindering the user experience.
03
Web Digital Product
The development of the web-based digital product was a critical component of the solution. This product provided users with an intuitive platform to search, access, and interact with the Client’s extensive video content. Challenges such as ensuring a responsive design, secure user authentication, and efficient search functionalities were addressed effectively. The result was a robust platform that enhanced user engagement and accessibility, providing a seamless experience across various devices and ensuring that healthcare professionals could easily find and utilize the content they needed.
Results
The collaboration between MetaDesign Solutions and the Client resulted in a transformative solution that significantly improved the management and accessibility of vast amounts of video content. The AI-powered tool streamlined the organization and summarization of video data, while the web-based platform provided users with an intuitive and secure way to access this content. The solution not only addressed the Client’s immediate challenges but also positioned them for future growth, with scalable technology and automation that can adapt to increasing volumes of content. The successful implementation of this project has enhanced the Client’s ability to deliver high-quality educational content to healthcare professionals worldwide, solidifying their position as a leader in the industry.

headings.text: Enhancing patient care and accessibility: streamlining appointment booking and telemedicine services for Medanta Hospital
Integration with HIS and Other Tools

pages.content:
By
Sukriti Srivastava
/
Enhancing patient care and accessibility: streamlining appointment booking and telemedicine services for Medanta Hospital
Overview
MetaDesign Solutions successfully developed a comprehensive Web and Mobile Application for Medanta Hospital, enabling seamless appointment booking for physical and telemedicine consultations. Integrated with the hospital's HIS and various third-party systems, the solution ensures a secure, efficient, and user-friendly experience for patients and healthcare providers alike, facilitating better healthcare access.
about the client
Medanta Hospital, founded by the esteemed Dr. Naresh Trehan, is one of India's largest multi-speciality tertiary care providers. With a mission to deliver advanced yet affordable medical services, Medanta has established itself as a leader in healthcare, operating across multiple major cities in India. The hospital is renowned for its state-of-the-art facilities and a team of highly experienced doctors trained at some of the world's most prestigious institutions. Medanta's commitment to quality care is reflected in its consistent ranking as the best private hospital in India from 2020 to 2023 and its inclusion in Newsweek's list of the top 250 global hospitals in 2023.
The hospital's organizational structure promotes collaboration and multispecialty care integration, ensuring that patients receive the highest standard of care. Medanta's dedication to excellence in healthcare delivery makes it a trusted name among patients seeking specialized treatment across various medical disciplines.
Industry Domain
Allied Healthcare and Medical Devices
Service Category (Service-line)
Web App Development / Mobile App Development / Video Conferencing / Payments
Technologies Used
MongoDB, Node
Amazon Web Services (AWS)
Angular, React
Android
iOS
Challenges
Ensuring secure coding practices to maintain patient data privacy in compliance with healthcare regulations.
Seamlessly integrating the application with multiple third-party systems, including the hospital's HIS.
Managing complex payment processing and credit management within the application.
Implementing reliable video conferencing for telemedicine, optimized for varying device types and low-bandwidth conditions.
Ensuring the application’s resilience, with smooth operation even when dependent systems encounter failures.
Solution Scope and Services
MetaDesign Solutions undertook the development of a comprehensive Web and Mobile Application for Medanta Hospital to streamline the appointment booking process, encompassing both physical and telemedicine consultations. The solution was designed to be highly user-friendly, allowing patients to find doctors based on their symptoms, ailments, or departmental requirements, and book appointments for themselves or their family members. Key features include secure uploading of medical reports during booking and user-specific interfaces for coordinators, admins, doctors, and patients.
The solution scope also involved creating a robust reporting system to generate customized reports as needed by various stakeholders. Additionally, the application integrated with Zoom for telemedicine video conferencing, ensuring that virtual consultations could be conducted seamlessly across multiple devices, even in low-bandwidth scenarios. MetaDesign Solutions successfully addressed the challenges posed by complex system integrations and secure data handling, delivering a solution that significantly improved patient access to healthcare services.
01
Application Development
MetaDesign Solutions employed Java for backend development, ensuring a robust, secure, and scalable architecture. The frontend was developed using Angular, providing a responsive and intuitive user interface. This combination of technologies allowed the team to build a high-performance application that meets the demanding needs of a healthcare environment, ensuring seamless interaction for all user personas, including patients, doctors, and administrators.
02
In-House Data Center Hosting
The application was hosted on Medanta Hospital’s in-house data center, leveraging advanced load balancers, automated backups, and security protocols to ensure minimal downtime and optimal performance. The setup was designed to scale as needed, accommodating the growing number of users and appointments while maintaining data integrity and system reliability. This on-premise hosting solution allowed Medanta to retain full control over its IT infrastructure, ensuring compliance with healthcare data regulations and internal policies.
03
Integration with HIS and Other Tools
The application was seamlessly integrated with Medanta’s Hospital Information System (HIS) and various third-party tools, ensuring smooth and uninterrupted operation. MetaDesign Solutions implemented fail-safe mechanisms to allow the application to continue functioning even if certain systems were down, providing users with clear error messages and alternative options. This integration was crucial in maintaining the continuity of healthcare services, allowing the hospital to deliver a consistent and reliable patient experience.
Results
The development and deployment of the Web and Mobile Application for Medanta Hospital by MetaDesign Solutions marked a significant advancement in the hospital's ability to offer patient-centric care. The solution not only simplified the appointment booking process for patients but also empowered doctors and administrators with the tools they need to manage schedules and consultations effectively.
By ensuring secure data handling, seamless system integrations, and reliable telemedicine services, the application has significantly enhanced patient access to healthcare, particularly in remote areas where physical consultations may be challenging. The positive impact of this solution is evident in the improved patient satisfaction and operational efficiency at Medanta Hospital, further solidifying its position as a leader in the healthcare industry.

headings.text: MetaDesign Solutions successfully developed a seamless integration system using Dell Boomi, facilitating centralized employee data management and real-time synchronization between HR platforms, reducing payroll processing time by 70% and improving employee satisfaction by 20%
Leveraging Dell Boomi for Seamless Integration
Ensuring Data Security and Privacy in HR Systems
Scalable Cloud Deployment for Future Growth

pages.content:
By
Pooja Makkar
/
MetaDesign Solutions successfully developed a seamless integration system using Dell Boomi, facilitating centralized employee data management and real-time synchronization between HR platforms, reducing payroll processing time by 70% and improving employee satisfaction by 20%
Overview
MetaDesign Solutions partnered with a leading global HR services provider to integrate two major HR platforms, SuccessFactors and Dayforce, using Dell Boomi. The integration aimed to centralize employee data management, automate onboarding, and ensure accurate, real-time synchronization of employee details such as promotions, transfers, and compensation. This solution drastically improved HR data accuracy, enhanced scalability, and streamlined payroll processing.
about the client
The client is a leading global provider of human resources and workforce management solutions. With a focus on delivering innovative HR technology, the company offers comprehensive platforms to manage employee data, payroll, and talent management for businesses worldwide. Their flagship products, including SuccessFactors and Dayforce, serve companies across various industries by providing advanced features for HR operations, such as employee data management, real-time updates, and payroll solutions.
The client sought to enhance the integration between their systems, aiming to centralize employee data from various countries into a unified platform, improve payroll accuracy, and streamline HR processes. MetaDesign Solutions was selected to develop a robust integration using Dell Boomi, providing a scalable solution for future growth.
Industry Domain
Professional Services
Service Category (Service-line)
Dell BOOMI SuccessFactors
Technologies Used
EDI Integration
Dell BOOMI
Data Transformation
ERP Integrations
Challenges
Data Synchronization Complexity : The integration of multiple HR systems required developing complex Boomi processes to ensure accurate synchronization of employee data between SuccessFactors and Dayforce, particularly for country-specific data.
Data Security and Privacy : The integration involved sensitive employee information, necessitating advanced data encryption and secure transfer methods to protect privacy.
System Monitoring and Error Handling : The need for continuous monitoring and robust error handling mechanisms to manage data flow, troubleshoot issues, and ensure the reliability of the synchronization process.
Scalability : As the client required a system that could accommodate future expansions, it was crucial to design a scalable solution that could easily integrate new endpoints and handle growing volumes of data.
Solution Scope and Services
MetaDesign Solutions developed an automated, cloud-based integration system using Dell Boomi to synchronize employee data across the SuccessFactors and Dayforce platforms. The system was designed to handle real-time updates and trigger-based data transfers, which streamlined employee onboarding, promotions, compensation, and payroll processes.
The integration also featured the use of SFTP for secure data transfer and email connectors to notify payroll teams in different countries. The solution's scalability was enhanced through cloud deployment, ensuring that additional endpoints could be easily added in the future. The key goal was to reduce manual data entry, increase payroll accuracy, and improve HR data consistency.
01
Leveraging Dell Boomi for Seamless Integration
Dell Boomi played a central role in this project by providing a robust integration platform to synchronize data between SuccessFactors and Dayforce. Boomi’s pre-built connectors and cloud-native capabilities allowed MetaDesign Solutions to develop a secure, scalable solution that could integrate various systems and streamline data transfer processes, reducing the complexity and cost of managing HR data.
02
Ensuring Data Security and Privacy in HR Systems
One of the primary challenges of this integration was ensuring the security of sensitive employee information. MetaDesign Solutions implemented data encryption and secure transfer methods, including SFTP and email connectors, to ensure that employee data was protected throughout the entire process. This focus on security helped the client comply with privacy regulations and safeguard sensitive information.
03
Scalable Cloud Deployment for Future Growth
The integration solution was designed with scalability in mind, leveraging cloud-based deployment to ensure that new endpoints could be added easily as the client’s operations expanded. This scalable architecture not only supported the client’s current needs but also positioned them for future growth by allowing the system to accommodate increasing volumes of data and integration requirements over time.
Results
The integration system developed by MetaDesign Solutions delivered substantial improvements in data accuracy, operational efficiency, and scalability for the client. Payroll processing time was reduced by 70%, while data entry time was cut by 40%, leading to significant cost savings. Furthermore, the real-time synchronization and streamlined HR processes contributed to a 20% improvement in employee satisfaction scores.
The success of this project highlights MetaDesign Solutions’ expertise in using Dell Boomi integration services for complex integrations and delivering scalable, secure solutions that meet the evolving needs of global businesses.

headings.text: Revolutionizing blue-collar hiring through ai: metadesign solutions leverages advanced ai technologies to streamline job matching, candidate recommendations, and profile analysis for a leading employment platform

pages.content:
By
Pooja Makkar
/
Revolutionizing blue-collar hiring through ai: metadesign solutions leverages advanced ai technologies to streamline job matching, candidate recommendations, and profile analysis for a leading employment platform
Overview
MetaDesign Solutions successfully developed and enhanced a state-of-the-art job-matching platform that caters to blue-collar industries. Using cutting-edge AI technologies such as LlamaIndex, OpenAI, and custom Python-based algorithms, we automated complex business processes, including candidate-job matching, AI-driven chatbots, and the generation of trust scores based on candidates' past performance. This solution has enabled the client to eliminate traditional recruitment bottlenecks, significantly improving hiring efficiency while ensuring trust and transparency between candidates and employers.
about the client
The client, a prominent online employment platform based in Australia, specializes in connecting blue-collar job seekers with employers. Their platform, which integrates with several other leading job websites, has established itself as a key player in industries requiring skilled labor. The client’s mission is to simplify the recruitment process for both employers and candidates by offering an intuitive, AI-powered platform that automates many traditional recruitment tasks. This approach helps employers fill positions faster and more reliably, while job seekers benefit from streamlined job search and application processes.
At the core of the platform is a robust database of job listings and profiles, organized to provide the most relevant results for users. The platform's unique selling point lies in its patented technology for verifying candidate skills, improving trust in the hiring process. By focusing on high-demand industries and cutting-edge technology, the client offers a modern solution to the ongoing challenges of finding qualified blue-collar workers.
Industry Domain
Professional Services
Service Category (Service-line)
AI Engineering / LLM / Digital Product Development
Technologies Used
LLama
OpenAI
Python
React
AWS
Challenges
Complex Job Matching : The platform required the automation of intricate business rules to match candidates with the most suitable jobs, considering factors like skills, location, and past employment history.
AI-Driven Chatbots : Development of AI-powered chatbots to engage with employers and provide instant support, making the hiring process smoother.
Profile Parsing : Automating the parsing of candidate profiles to generate meaningful data that could be utilized for more precise job recommendations.
Trust Score Calculation : Implementing AI algorithms to generate a trust score for candidates based on work history, ratings, and reviews.
Scalability : Ensuring that the platform could handle increasing user demands without compromising performance.
Solution Scope and Services
MetaDesign Solutions designed and developed a comprehensive AI-based platform to enhance various business processes for the client. The solution included advanced candidate matching algorithms that could sift through thousands of profiles and recommend the most suitable candidates for employers. Additionally, we integrated a conversational AI-driven chatbot to assist employers in navigating the platform and managing job postings seamlessly.
We utilized Python, LlamaIndex, and OpenAI models to implement AI algorithms that analyze candidate profiles, summarize their experience, and generate meaningful insights to enhance job recommendations. A key feature was the development of a trust score mechanism, which calculates a candidate’s reliability based on prior reviews and work history. This score improved the confidence of employers when selecting candidates, addressing the trust factor crucial in blue-collar hiring.
01
AI-Driven Candidate Matching
Leveraging the capabilities of LlamaIndex and OpenAI, the platform's AI-driven job-matching process intelligently connects candidates with jobs based on skill sets, location, and work history. This reduces the time to hire and ensures a more accurate match, addressing the critical challenge of hiring the right candidate efficiently in high-demand industries.
02
Trust Score Implementation
Using advanced AI models, the platform introduced a trust score system that evaluates a candidate's reliability based on past performance, ratings, and reviews. This feature has significantly improved employer confidence during the hiring process by providing a quantifiable measure of trustworthiness, thus minimizing the risk of bad hires.
03
Scaling with NodeJS and Python
To handle a growing user base and increasing platform demands, MetaDesign Solutions utilized the scalability of NodeJS for the backend and Python for AI processes. This combination allowed the platform to grow efficiently while maintaining high performance, even as more users and complex job listings were added.
Results
By partnering with MetaDesign Solutions, the client was able to automate and enhance many key functionalities of their platform. This resulted in faster job placements, better candidate recommendations, and improved transparency between candidates and employers. The integration of AI-driven processes significantly reduced manual effort, allowing the client to provide a more efficient and scalable service. The trust score feature, in particular, has proven to be a game-changer, as employers can now make more informed hiring decisions.
Our collaboration has successfully positioned the client’s platform as a top choice for blue-collar recruitment, providing substantial value to both job seekers and employers through enhanced automation and AI-driven insights.

pages.content:
By

Empowering employment: MetaDesign Solutions revolutionizes jobdroid with cutting-edge mobile application technology
Overview
MetaDesign Solutions has successfully engineered an innovative mobile application for JobDroid, Australia’s leading job portal for blue-collar positions. This project integrated advanced Flutter SDK and WebView technologies to deliver a seamless user experience for job seekers, optimizing interaction and functionality across both Android and iOS platforms. This solution exemplifies MetaDesign's expertise in blending sophisticated software development techniques to meet client needs effectively.
about the client
JobDroid is a prominent online job portal based in Brisbane, Australia, dedicated to bridging the gap between blue-collar workers and potential employers. As an alternative to traditional employment agencies, JobDroid offers a platform that is both transparent and user-directed, enabling job seekers and employers to interact directly and efficiently. Their mission is to streamline the employment process, removing the typical constraints and sales-driven agendas of conventional recruitment. JobDroid’s innovative approach includes patented technology for verifying candidate skills, ensuring both parties can connect with confidence and clarity, thus making the hiring process quicker and more precise.
Industry Domain
Professional Services
Service Category (Service-line)
Mobile App Development / Hybrid App Development
Technologies Used
Flutter
Angular
Challenges
Integrating a common codebase for both Android and iOS using Flutter to ensure consistent functionality and design across platforms.
Embedding web components developed in Angular within the mobile apps without compromising performance or user experience.
Managing the seamless transition between native Flutter components and web-based Angular components within the app.
Ensuring high performance and responsiveness of the mobile application despite the complex integration of different technologies.
Adapting the existing web functionalities into a mobile-friendly format without losing operational integrity.
Solution Scope and Services
The project encompassed developing a robust mobile application using a hybrid of Flutter and WebView technologies to cater specifically to job seekers. This application allows users to find jobs, manage timesheets, and communicate directly with employers through an integrated messaging system. By leveraging Flutter, MetaDesign Solutions facilitated a unified codebase across multiple platforms, enhancing maintainability and scalability. Simultaneously, Angular components were seamlessly integrated within the mobile environment to ensure that existing web functionalities were preserved, providing a consistent user experience across different devices.
01
Mobile App Development using Flutter
Using Flutter SDK, MetaDesign Solutions crafted a cross-platform mobile application that maintains high performance and aesthetic consistency across both Android and iOS systems. This approach not only streamlined development processes but also significantly reduced time-to-market, allowing JobDroid to quickly enhance their service offerings for job seekers.
02
Mashup Web Components and Flutter
The integration of Angular web components within the Flutter-based application posed unique challenges, particularly in maintaining smooth performance transitions and functional parity. MetaDesign Solutions tackled these by implementing advanced coding practices and optimization techniques, ensuring that the mobile application could host web components effectively without hindering the user experience.
Results
MetaDesign Solutions’ development of JobDroid’s mobile application represents a significant advancement in how job portals can serve their users more effectively. The innovative use of Flutter and WebView technologies not only enhanced the functionality of the JobDroid platform but also improved user engagement and satisfaction. The seamless integration of web components within the mobile app ensured that users received a consistent experience, akin to the web platform, but with the added convenience of mobile access. This development has positioned JobDroid as a frontrunner in the employment industry, setting a new standard for how job portals operate and engage with their audiences. The success of this project underscores MetaDesign Solutions' role as a leader in mobile application development, ready to meet the challenges of dynamic market needs and technological advancements.

pages.description: Learn how MetaDesign Solutions developed a robust digital platform for FintEdu, combining WordPress and Moodle into a seamless 'Woodle' stack. headings.text: Empowering FintEdu with a seamless digital learning experience through a unified WordPress and Moodle integration
WordPress and Moodle Integration and Co-Existence

pages.content:
By
Sukriti Srivastava
/
Empowering FintEdu with a seamless digital learning experience through a unified WordPress and Moodle integration
Overview
MetaDesign Solutions successfully delivered a robust digital platform for FintEdu, a leading e-learning portal for finance and accounting professionals in the Middle East. By integrating WordPress and Moodle into a unified "Woodle" stack, we created a seamless experience that combines the content management power of WordPress with the learning management capabilities of Moodle, allowing users to access courses, certifications, and industry insights all in one place.
about the client
FintEdu.com is a premier technology-driven education platform designed for finance, tax, and accounting professionals in the Middle East. The platform offers a wealth of resources, including a comprehensive library of Gulf region laws, insightful articles by industry experts, and a dynamic Q&A forum that fosters collaborative learning. FintEdu’s commitment to providing timely and relevant information makes it an indispensable tool for professionals looking to stay ahead in a rapidly evolving industry.
FintEdu’s mission is to equip professionals with the knowledge and skills necessary to navigate the complexities of the global marketplace. Their vision is to become the foremost provider of innovative e-learning solutions that enable continuous professional growth. To this end, FintEdu offers an e-learning hub where users can access SCORM-compliant courses, earn certifications, and enhance their expertise through an intuitive and engaging online platform.
Industry Domain
Financial Services
Service Category (Service-line)
Web Portal / eLearning / CMS Website
Technologies Used
Moodle
WordPress
MySQL
AWS
Challenges
Integration Complexity: Seamlessly integrating WordPress and Moodle into a cohesive digital platform posed significant technical challenges, particularly in ensuring data synchronization and consistent user experiences.
Payment Processing and Subscriptions: Implementing a secure and reliable payment gateway that supports subscriptions and one-time payments required careful planning and robust Stripe integration.
Unified User Interface: Developing a consistent user interface across both WordPress and Moodle platforms was crucial to providing a seamless experience for end-users.
Single Sign-On (SSO) Implementation: Creating an SSO solution to allow users to access both WordPress and Moodle with a single login was essential to enhance user convenience and streamline access.
Solution Scope and Services
MetaDesign Solutions undertook the challenge of developing a fully integrated digital platform for FintEdu, leveraging the strengths of both WordPress and Moodle. The project scope included designing a unified user interface, integrating a secure payment gateway, and ensuring seamless navigation between the e-learning platform and the main website. Our team developed custom features in Moodle to cater to FintEdu's unique requirements, including SCORM-compliant course delivery, certification tracking, and advanced analytics.
We also created a custom theme that ensured consistency in the look and feel of the platform, whether users were browsing content pages or engaging with the e-learning materials. The integration of WordPress and Moodle through a single sign-on (SSO) solution further enhanced the user experience, allowing for smooth transitions between the CMS and LMS environments. Collectively, these efforts culminated in the development of a sophisticated, user-friendly platform known as "Woodle."
01
LMS Development using Moodle
Using Moodle as the backbone for FintEdu's Learning Management System (LMS) enabled us to deliver a flexible and scalable e-learning solution. Moodle's open-source nature allowed for extensive customization to meet FintEdu's specific needs, including SCORM compliance for course delivery, automated certification issuance, and comprehensive reporting features. This approach ensured that FintEdu could offer a high-quality learning experience that was both engaging and effective for professionals in the finance and accounting sectors.
02
Website Development using WordPress
The development of FintEdu's website using WordPress presented unique challenges, particularly in maintaining visual and functional consistency across different platforms. By customizing themes and leveraging WordPress’s SEO-friendly structure, we ensured that the website was not only visually appealing but also optimized for search engines. The careful integration of WordPress with Moodle allowed for a cohesive user experience, where users could seamlessly transition between informational pages and interactive learning modules without any disruption.
03
WordPress and Moodle Integration and Co-Existence
The integration of WordPress and Moodle into a unified "Woodle" stack was a key success factor in the project. This approach combined the best of both worlds—WordPress's powerful content management capabilities and Moodle's robust learning management features. The challenge was to create a seamless experience where both platforms co-exist and function as a single entity. We achieved this by implementing a sophisticated SSO system and ensuring consistent UI/UX design, thereby providing FintEdu with a powerful digital platform that enhances both user engagement and administrative efficiency.
Results
The collaboration between FintEdu and MetaDesign Solutions resulted in the creation of a cutting-edge e-learning platform that meets the needs of finance and accounting professionals across the Middle East. The integration of WordPress and Moodle into the "Woodle" stack has enabled FintEdu to offer a seamless and engaging user experience, combining the best features of both platforms. The custom features developed in Moodle have provided FintEdu with the tools necessary to deliver high-quality educational content, while WordPress's flexibility has ensured that the platform remains accessible and user-friendly.
Overall, the solution developed by MetaDesign Solutions has had a positive impact on FintEdu’s business, enhancing its ability to attract and retain users, streamline operations, and maintain its position as a leading provider of e-learning solutions in the Middle East. The successful implementation of this project underscores MetaDesign Solutions' commitment to delivering innovative and effective digital solutions that drive business success.

headings.text: Empowering early years education with a seamless digital experience: MetaDesign Solutions develops a robust and scalable mobile and backend solution for a digital native

pages.content:
By
Sukriti Srivastava
/
Empowering early years education with a seamless digital experience: MetaDesign Solutions develops a robust and scalable mobile and backend solution for a digital native
Overview
MetaDesign Solutions successfully developed a comprehensive mobile and backend solution for a digital native, the leading ERP platform for nursery schools in the UK. The solution, encompassing both Android and iOS applications, supports various early learning frameworks and enables teachers to digitize observations and streamline administrative tasks. The project addressed complex challenges such as multi-framework compatibility, offline-online synchronization, and support for diverse tablet devices, ultimately enhancing the efficiency and engagement of nursery operations.
about the client
The digital native is a pioneering provider of ERP solutions tailored for nursery schools. Their platform is an all-in-one solution that assists nursery owners, managers, and practitioners in efficiently managing every aspect of their operations. From child registration and session scheduling to staff management and observation recording, the digital native offers a range of tools that reduce paperwork, save time, and improve overall operational efficiency.
The platform supports multiple early years learning frameworks, including EYFS, Montessori, and others, ensuring that nurseries can adhere to various educational standards. It also facilitates seamless communication between parents and teachers, allowing parents to stay updated on their child's progress through a dedicated social app. The digital native mission is to empower nursery professionals by simplifying business processes and enhancing the quality of early childhood education. Over time, the digital native has become the preferred choice for childcare providers, offering an affordable and comprehensive solution that caters to the entire nursery community.
Industry Domain
Allied Healthcare (Child Care and Development)
Service Category (Service-line)
Mobile App Development / Cloud Backend Development
Technologies Used
Android
IOS
YII
PHP
AWS
Challenges
Multi-Framework Compatibility : The application needed to support 15 different early years learning frameworks, requiring a flexible and adaptable backend.
Offline/Online Synchronization : Teachers needed the ability to capture and upload photos and videos during sessions, necessitating a robust offline-online sync mechanism.
Diverse Device Support : The solution had to work seamlessly across various tablet screen sizes, vendors, and operating system versions.

This allowed Samsung to deploy, scale, and manage their applications efficiently. The use of these technologies ensured minimal downtime, easy scaling during traffic surges, and better resource utilization across their cloud ecosystem.

Renowned for their deep expertise in the mortgage lending and real estate space, they have successfully integrated modern technological solutions to streamline property management processes for community owners, property managers, and tenants.
With a growing portfolio of properties under management, they identified a need for a digital platform to better track, verify, and manage tenant and resident data, while ensuring compliance with local and federal regulations. The solution required automation to reduce manual processes, integration with government databases to validate submitted documents, and a streamlined user interface that was accessible from both desktop and mobile devices. Seamlessly bridging email and stakeholder management: an outlook add-in for enhanced efficiency

about the client
The client is a prominent player in the stakeholder relationship management (SRM) industry, offering a cloud-based platform that simplifies and enhances how organizations handle stakeholder interactions. Their software is particularly popular with governments, non-profit organizations, and industries such as energy and community development, where maintaining and managing complex relationships is crucial.
Their primary product is an SRM tool designed to log and track communications, set reminders, and manage various interactions with stakeholders. It’s an all-in-one hub for managing relationships and ensuring transparency and compliance with stakeholder commitments. By offering a cloud-based, secure, and user-friendly solution, the client enables organizations to manage stakeholder data, engagements, and project documentation with ease, leading to more informed decisions and improved project outcomes.
Headquartered in Victoria, Canada, the client has a global reach, serving various industries that rely on robust and organized stakeholder management systems to ensure seamless project execution and strong communication with their stakeholders.

Technology
Service Category (Service-line)
Outlook Plug-in Development / Office Plug-in Development / Digital Product Development
Technologies Used
ReactJS
HTML5
CSS3
Office Add-in SDK

Seamless API Integration : Achieving deep integration between Outlook 365 and the client’s SRM system required careful handling of their REST APIs to ensure smooth data flow.

User Experience : Delivering an intuitive and easy-to-use interface within Outlook while maintaining complex functionalities was key to user adoption.
Cross-Platform Support : The add-in needed to work seamlessly on both desktop and web versions of Outlook 365.

The Outlook add-in developed by MetaDesign Solutions serves as a bridge between the client’s SRM platform and Outlook 365. It allows users to manage their communication and contacts effortlessly, ensuring that all engagements with stakeholders are logged in real-time. Using the SRM platform's REST APIs, we built deep integration features such as email tracking, contact updates, and calendar syncing—all accessible from within Outlook.
The solution also offers attachment management, where files from emails are automatically saved to the SRM system. Users can easily retrieve these files and attach them to new emails. This not only simplifies the process of tracking communications but also ensures that all stakeholder interactions are stored in a centralized, secure location.
01
Cross-Platform Outlook Add-in Using ReactJS

This provided users with a unified interface, allowing them to manage contacts, track communication, and sync events without ever leaving Outlook.

By hosting the add-in on AWS S3, we ensured scalability and security. This cloud infrastructure allows the client to accommodate growing user bases while ensuring fast load times and secure data handling across all devices, offering a reliable solution for stakeholder management.

The custom-built Outlook add-in transformed how the client’s users interact with both their email and SRM system, leading to a more efficient and organized workflow. By combining ReactJS and the Office Add-in SDK, MetaDesign Solutions delivered a feature-rich, easy-to-use product that enhances productivity and ensures seamless integration with the client’s platform.
As a result of this development, the client can now offer their users a powerful tool that saves time and effort by automating the tracking of emails, contacts, and calendar events—ultimately improving stakeholder management and engagement.

Enhancing engineering efficiency by integrating real-time hardware design data into Word documents through a custom Valispace Add-in, developed by MetaDesign Solutions
Overview
Founded in 2016, Valispace is a collaborative platform designed to streamline hardware development for engineering teams working on complex projects such as satellites, medical devices, and cars. Based in Bremen, Germany, with operations in Lisbon, Portugal, Valispace focuses on providing engineers a single source of truth for their design parameters. Their software allows real-time updates and automation of engineering workflows, from specifying requirements to conducting trade-offs. Valispace's platform has garnered attention for its ability to reduce manual documentation tasks, accelerate product development, and improve design accuracy.
With over 100 companies using Valispace’s platform across industries like aerospace, automotive, and robotics, Valispace plays a crucial role in managing precision and traceability in hardware development. Their integration of AI helps engineers write formal requirements and manage complex changes, further reducing human errors. Valispace continues to grow its influence in the engineering software market, recently being acquired by Altium, a leader in electronics design software.
about the client
Valispace, founded in 2015 and headquartered in Bremen, Germany, is a company that specializes in developing browser-based engineering software designed to store and organize engineering design parameters.   Their platform streamlines the entire engineering process, encompassing requirements engineering, system design, testing, verification, and validation.  By providing a centralized, collaborative environment, Valispace enables engineering teams to efficiently manage complex hardware projects, ensuring consistency and traceability throughout the development lifecycle.
Serving industries such as aerospace, automotive, energy, and medical devices, Valispace addresses the critical business challenge of managing dynamic engineering data central to hardware development.   Their platform offers full traceability, a single place to collaborate, manage test procedures, and retrieve information about decisions and choices, enabling clients to reduce development time, boost quality, and cut down costs across all projects.   By integrating various aspects of the engineering workflow into a cohesive system, Valispace helps organizations overcome the inefficiencies associated with fragmented tools and manual data handling, leading to more streamlined and effective product development processes.
Industry Domain
Technology
Service Category (Service-line)
Word Add-in / Office Add-in Development / Digital Product Development
Technologies Used
C#
VSTO Add-in SDK
Microsoft Office SDK
Challenges
Data Synchronization : Enabling real-time synchronization of dynamic fields (Valis, graphs, matrices) between Valispace and Word without altering document formatting.
Cross-Platform Compatibility : Developing a plugin compatible with both offline and online versions of Word, including Word 365, Mac, and earlier versions.
Scalability : Ensuring the plugin could handle large-scale engineering projects with extensive data points while maintaining performance.
User Experience : Migrating from a VSTO add-in to an Office Add-in while maintaining a smooth, intuitive user interface.
Custom Test Procedure Integration : Adding support for test procedures and steps within Word, allowing engineers to manage validation documentation directly within their projects.
Solution Scope and Services
MetaDesign Solutions developed an advanced Word Add-in for Valispace, building upon the existing toolset while migrating the plugin to the more robust "Office Add-ins" framework using JavaScript and TypeScript. This solution enabled seamless integration of Valispace’s real-time data into Word documents, ensuring that design parameters such as values, matrices, and graphs could be dynamically inserted and refreshed directly within a user’s documentation. Furthermore, MetaDesign Solutions ensured that even offline users could benefit from the plugin, deploying the add-in in air-gapped systems as needed.
The project also involved improving the user interface by incorporating a sidebar for selecting Valispace data fields and providing dynamic display options. MetaDesign Solutions enhanced the plugin’s ability to insert test procedures, verification methods, and entire analyses from Valispace into Word, allowing engineers to efficiently manage requirements, tests, and validation processes.
01
Cross-Platform Development Using Office Add-ins Technology
The shift to "Office Add-ins" technology using JavaScript/TypeScript was crucial for enabling compatibility across various versions of Word, both online and offline. This development ensures that Valispace users can access the add-in regardless of the platform or environment they work in, allowing teams to continue their workflows even in air-gapped or disconnected systems.
02
Automating Test Procedure Documentation
The new plugin enables users to insert detailed test procedures and steps directly from Valispace into Word documents. This automation allows engineers to manage validation processes within the same environment as their design documents, ensuring a unified and traceable documentation workflow from requirements to verification.
03
Seamless Real-Time Data Updates
MetaDesign Solutions ensured that the add-in supports real-time updates, allowing users to refresh data fields with the latest Valispace inputs. Whether values, matrices, or graphs, all design parameters can be updated automatically or manually without losing formatting, offering greater precision and accuracy in engineering documentation.
Results
The collaboration between MetaDesign Solutions and Valispace resulted in a significantly enhanced Word Add-in that improves workflow efficiency for hardware development teams. By enabling real-time synchronization of engineering data, the add-in allows users to insert and refresh dynamic fields within Word documents seamlessly. The move to the "Office Add-ins" technology with JavaScript/TypeScript enhanced the plugin’s cross-platform compatibility and performance, benefiting teams working on complex projects across industries. Valispace’s engineering teams now enjoy streamlined documentation processes, reducing manual errors and increasing productivity, ultimately accelerating product development lifecycles.

headings.text: Crafting a seamless smartTV experience: elevating Holiday-Feelings OTT platform with scenic serenity and meditative bliss

pages.content:
By
Sukriti Srivastava
/
Crafting a seamless smartTV experience: elevating Holiday-Feelings OTT platform with scenic serenity and meditative bliss
Overview
Metadesign Solutions (MDS) partnered with Holiday-Feelings to develop an immersive SmartTV application that brings the tranquility of scenic landscapes and meditative experiences directly into users' homes. Leveraging our expertise in OTT platforms, we seamlessly integrated handcrafted content into a user-friendly interface, allowing audiences to escape their everyday stress and indulge in moments of pure relaxation. Through this collaboration, we transformed Holiday-Feelings' vision into a captivating digital experience, enhancing their offering and providing viewers with an oasis of calm at their fingertips.
about the client
Holiday-Feelings is a cutting-edge OTT platform designed to bring the calming essence of vacation destinations directly into your living room. With a carefully curated selection of scenic and meditative videos, the platform captures the magic of being away—where the stresses of everyday life dissolve, and one can fully embrace the beauty of the moment. From mesmerizing sunsets to tranquil landscapes, each video is crafted to create an immersive experience that soothes the mind, body, and soul.
At the heart of Holiday-Feelings is the idea of transforming any space into a personal oasis of relaxation. Whether it’s unwinding after a long day, engaging in a meditation session, or simply enjoying a peaceful evening, the platform offers a unique escape that enhances well-being. Accompanied by the soothing sounds of nature or finely tuned music, viewers can effortlessly slip into a state of calm and serenity, making it easy to leave the hustle and bustle behind.
Holiday-Feelings is more than just an entertainment platform; it’s a gateway to tranquility. By offering a virtual retreat from the demands of daily life, it allows users to create moments of peace and rejuvenation whenever they need it. Whether alone or with loved ones, Holiday-Feelings provides a seamless way to experience the therapeutic benefits of nature and mindfulness, all from the comfort of home.
Industry Domain
Media
Service Category (Service-line)
OTT Application / Digital Product Engineering / Smart TV Application
Technologies Used
Flutter, Tizen SDK, HTML5 / CSS3, Android TV
Challenges
Creating a Common Codebase for Multiple Smart TV Operating Systems: We developed a unified codebase compatible with Tizen, Android TV, Apple TV, and WebOS. This streamlined development, allowing us to deploy and maintain the app efficiently across various platforms.
Seamless Streaming of Large Videos: To handle the high-resolution scenic videos, we optimized streaming protocols and employed adaptive bitrate streaming. This ensured smooth playback and minimal buffering, even with large video files.
Securing Content Streaming: We implemented robust DRM and secure streaming protocols to protect Holiday-Feelings' premium content from unauthorized access, ensuring secure content delivery across all platforms.
Supporting Multiple Smart TV Manufacturers: We optimized the app for various Smart TV brands and models, ensuring consistent performance and compatibility across different hardware configurations.
Optimizing Application Size: To keep the app size manageable, we optimized code, compressed assets, and employed efficient data management, ensuring quick installation and smooth performance without compromising quality.
Solution Scope and Services
In this project, Metadesign Solutions (MDS) collaborated with Holiday-Feelings to develop a SmartTV application that delivers their signature scenic and meditative content across multiple platforms, including Tizen, Android TV, Apple TV, and WebOS. The project scope involved creating a seamless and immersive viewing experience while ensuring the application was compatible with various Smart TV operating systems and manufacturers. Our development strategy focused on building a unified codebase to streamline deployment and maintenance, optimizing video streaming for large, high-resolution files, and securing content delivery through robust DRM solutions.
Throughout the development process, we addressed key challenges such as ensuring smooth streaming of large videos, protecting premium content, and maintaining consistent performance across different Smart TV brands. Additionally, we optimized the application’s size to ensure quick installation and efficient operation on a wide range of devices. The result was a high-quality, user-friendly SmartTV app that successfully brought the relaxing and immersive Holiday-Feelings experience into the homes of users.
01
Flutter for SmartTV Development
We chose Flutter for the Smart TV development of Holiday-Feelings due to its capability to deliver a unified, high-performance application across multiple platforms with a single codebase. Flutter's flexibility allowed us to create a consistent and seamless user experience on various Smart TV operating systems, including Tizen, Android TV, Apple TV, and WebOS. Its rich set of pre-built widgets and tools facilitated the development of a visually appealing and responsive interface, while its robust framework ensured optimal performance and quick iterations. By leveraging Flutter, we efficiently managed cross-platform compatibility, streamlined the development process, and significantly reduced time-to-market.
02
Porting to support Tizen
Porting the Android TV app we developed using Flutter to Tizen was a strategic move to achieve our goal of maintaining a common codebase across multiple Smart TV platforms. By leveraging Flutter's cross-platform capabilities, we were able to adapt the app for Tizen with minimal modifications to the existing codebase. This approach ensured consistency in user experience while significantly reducing the development effort and time required to support an additional platform. The successful porting to Tizen not only demonstrated the flexibility and power of Flutter but also allowed us to deliver a seamless, high-quality application across both Android TV and Tizen, reinforcing our commitment to efficient and scalable development practices.
03
Porting to support LG WebOS
Porting the Flutter-based app to WebOS was a key step in extending support to LG-manufactured Smart TVs, ensuring broader accessibility for Holiday-Feelings’ audience. By adapting our common codebase to WebOS, we were able to efficiently bring the same immersive experience to LG Smart TVs while maintaining consistency across different platforms. The transition to WebOS involved optimizing the app to align with LG's specific hardware and software requirements, ensuring smooth performance and seamless integration. This successful port reinforced our strategy of using a unified codebase, allowing us to efficiently support a wide range of Smart TV manufacturers while delivering a high-quality, uniform experience to users.
Results
In conclusion, our collaboration with Holiday-Feelings to develop a SmartTV application across multiple platforms, including Tizen, Android TV, Apple TV, and WebOS, showcased our commitment to delivering a seamless and immersive user experience. By leveraging Flutter’s cross-platform capabilities, we efficiently managed to maintain a common codebase, ensuring consistency and reducing development time across different operating systems.
The successful porting to Tizen and WebOS further extended the app's reach, allowing us to support a wide range of Smart TV manufacturers, including LG. Through careful optimization and robust security measures, we delivered a high-quality application that brought the relaxing and tranquil experience of Holiday-Feelings directly into users' homes, fulfilling the project’s objectives and setting a strong foundation for future innovations.

pages.content:
By
