Efficiently navigating the future: Ayana Solutions’ seamless cross-platform navigation app, powered by MetaDesign Solutions
Overview
MetaDesign Solutions successfully developed a sophisticated mobile application for Ayana Solutions, leveraging Flutter SDK to create a cross-platform app for Android and iOS. The app, designed to enhance the navigation experience, integrates advanced features such as AI-driven mileage estimation for EVs, real-time vehicle telematics, and smart EV charging station recommendations. The solution, supported by a robust backend on AWS using NodeJS and MongoDB, demonstrates MetaDesign Solutions' expertise in delivering innovative, scalable, and efficient software solutions.
about the client
Ayana Solutions is a pioneering software solutions provider in the automotive industry, specializing in navigation and infotainment systems. Founded with a vision to transform automotive navigation, Ayana Mobility has grown into a global leader in providing navigation engines and map data solutions for automotive infotainment projects, catering to both passenger and commercial vehicle segments. Their extensive experience, spanning over two decades, stems from a team with deep roots in automotive manufacturing, infotainment Tier 1s, and navigation software companies. This wealth of knowledge and experience allows Ayana to deliver comprehensive, end-to-end solutions to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and Tier 1 suppliers worldwide.
Operating across the US, Europe, and Asia, Ayana Solutions boasts a strong global presence, supported by offshore engineering teams in France, Eastern Europe, and India. Their portfolio encompasses connected car solutions, onboard and hybrid navigation, IoT, embedded application development, and more. Through strategic partnerships and an innovative approach, Ayana Solutions helps its clients deliver differentiated experiences and real customer value, ensuring they remain at the forefront of the rapidly evolving automotive technology landscape.
Industry Domain
Technology, Automotive
Service Category (Service-line)
Mobile App Development / Automobile Solutions / Navigation Solution / Cloud Application Development
Technologies Used
Flutter
Cloud
AWS
NodeJS
MongoDB
Navigation SDK
Challenges
Maintaining a Unified Codebase: Ensuring a consistent user experience across both iOS and Android platforms using a single codebase.
Integration with Multiple SDKs: Seamlessly integrating third-party SDKs like HERE Maps and Sygic's navigation SDK while maintaining app performance.
Algorithm Optimization: Fine-tuning complex algorithms for accurate mileage estimation and efficient route planning.
Advanced Feature Support: Implementing sophisticated mobile app features such as real-time notifications, background processing, and vehicle telematics integration.
Scalable and Secure Backend: Developing a backend infrastructure that is both scalable to handle high traffic and secure to protect sensitive data.
Solution Scope and Services
The project scope encompassed the development of a cutting-edge mobile application tailored for the automotive industry, focusing on delivering a superior navigation experience for both conventional and electric vehicles (EVs). MetaDesign Solutions was tasked with creating an intuitive and reliable mobile app using the Flutter SDK, ensuring a consistent and high-quality experience across both Android and iOS platforms. The app featured advanced navigation capabilities, including AI-driven mileage estimation for EVs, real-time vehicle telematics, and smart recommendations for EV charging stations based on factors such as cost, queue, and distance.
In addition to the mobile app, the project also involved developing a robust backend infrastructure hosted on AWS, utilizing NodeJS and MongoDB technologies. The backend was designed to be scalable, secure, and capable of handling complex data processing tasks required by the app. MetaDesign Solutions also successfully integrated various third-party SDKs, including HERE Maps and Sygic's navigation SDK, to enhance the app's functionality and ensure seamless operation across different platforms. The project’s successful completion showcased MetaDesign Solutions' ability to deliver innovative, scalable, and efficient solutions tailored to the unique needs of the automotive industry.
01
Mobile App Development
MetaDesign Solutions employed the Flutter SDK to develop a cross-platform mobile application, ensuring that the navigation app could be deployed on both Android and iOS with a single codebase. This approach not only reduced development time but also ensured consistent user experience across both platforms. The app was designed to provide accurate navigation, integrate seamlessly with vehicle telematics, and offer real-time updates on driving conditions and EV charging stations, demonstrating the powerful capabilities of Flutter in delivering high-performance mobile applications.
02
Backend Development
The backend of the application was hosted on AWS, leveraging the cloud platform’s robust infrastructure to ensure scalability and reliability. MetaDesign Solutions utilized NodeJS and MongoDB to develop a backend that could efficiently manage and process the vast amounts of data required by the navigation app, from user data to real-time vehicle telematics. The backend was designed with security as a priority, ensuring that sensitive user information and vehicle data were protected while maintaining high performance and availability, even under heavy loads.
03
Integration with Third-Party SDKs
One of the critical aspects of the project was the seamless integration of various third-party SDKs, such as Sygic’s navigation SDK and HERE Maps, to enhance the app’s functionality. MetaDesign Solutions successfully integrated these SDKs, enabling advanced features like accurate driving instructions, route planning, and point-of-interest searches. Furthermore, the implementation of AI and machine learning algorithms allowed the app to provide intelligent recommendations for EV charging stations, considering factors like cost, queue times, and proximity, thereby delivering a smarter and more efficient user experience.
Results
The development of the navigation app for Ayana Solutions by MetaDesign Solutions marked a significant achievement in the automotive software domain. The successful implementation of a cross-platform mobile application, combined with a secure and scalable backend, demonstrated MetaDesign Solutions’ technical prowess and commitment to delivering high-quality software solutions. The app’s advanced features, including AI-driven mileage estimation and smart EV charging recommendations, not only met but exceeded Ayana Solutions’ expectations, providing their customers with a superior navigation experience.
The positive impact of the solution is evident in Ayana Solutions’ enhanced ability to offer innovative and differentiated products to their clients in the automotive industry. By partnering with MetaDesign Solutions, Ayana Solutions was able to leverage cutting-edge technology to stay ahead of the competition, providing real value to their end-users and reinforcing their position as a leader in automotive navigation solutions.

Given the wide range of job profiles and the significant web traffic to handle, it was critical to develop a robust back-end infrastructure. Our d evelopment s ervices have led them in establishing themselves as a premier employment platform in Australia.

We built an integrated analytics solution merging data from multiple websites, portals and mobile apps to enable better understanding of user needs, content usage patterns and enable better personalization services. HCP portals offering targeted communications of pharma companies to their community of providers, HCPs and patients are a key engagement platform generating a wide range of data and information regarding the interactive events on the multiple frontends and backends of the services.
about the client
A global pharma company seeking to improve their communications and educational offerings and services, commercial offerings and market facing marketing through digital products.
Industry Domain
Pharmaceuticals and Life Sciences
Service Category (Service-line)
Data and Analytics

Web BackEnd (API) dev.
MySQL dB

GoogleQuery

Understanding the type/s of and the level of engagement is a useful input for improvement, as well as provides insight into content, its users and also uncovers new/un-discovered learning needs.
Creation of custom events.
The content is often spread out and the capture and assessment (measurement/interpretation) of the events is sometimes inconsistent and not unique.
Data duplication.
Visual representation of complex event streams.
To achieve this a comprehensive solution was needed, one which provides the necessary visual representation via dashboards of the data streams, as well as provides valuable interpretation and actionable insights.

Med-sci education content and pharma research communication in the field is a valuable tool for engaging with HCP users to enable them to remain updated on new therapies, research and developing science.
Considering the needs of the project and the pharma client’s requirement for a robust application built in collaboration with the business, we first undertook a full technical analysis of the existing technology implementations and data systems (Android, iOS, Web-backends) and developed the common application framework to extract the exact data required. This was then stored in a data-warehouse (Google) and then datasets processed further for individual frontends.

Using Google Looker Studio
MetaDesign Solutions utilized Google Looker Studio to build intuitive and interactive dashboards that visualize complex data streams. This tool enabled the Client to easily access and interpret data, offering clear insights into user engagement and content performance. The user-friendly interface of Looker Studio allowed for seamless integration with other Google services, providing a powerful visualization platform that met the Client’s needs for comprehensive reporting.

Unifying Data from Multiple Data Sources
One of the significant challenges was unifying data from various sources, including Android and iOS apps, web backends, and different storage technologies. MetaDesign Solutions developed a common application framework that facilitated the extraction and consolidation of data into a Google data warehouse. This process involved overcoming technical complexities related to data compatibility and synchronization, ensuring that all relevant data was accurately captured and made available for analysis.
03
Generating Meaningful Insights
Generating meaningful insights from the unified data was crucial for the Client's content strategy. MetaDesign Solutions' analytics solution enabled the extraction of actionable insights, helping the Client understand user behavior, engagement levels, and content preferences. These insights not only informed content personalization but also provided sponsors with clear evidence of their content's impact, thereby enhancing sponsor satisfaction and ROI.

Business value of analytics in determining and helping in interpreting the data related to macro and micro topics in a specialized field was possible. Especially on the aspects of content experience, ease of access/delivery, and analysis of learning benefits gained.

pages.content:
By

Park Education: Enhancing digital learning with Flutter
Overview
Park Education needed an application to deliver digital learning materials seamlessly across both Android and iOS platforms.
about the client
Founded in 1996, Park Education specializes in producing digital materials for language studies, business, technology, and creativity, offering a comprehensive bilingual and interdisciplinary approach to education.
Client's Problem
Park Education faced challenges in maintaining separate codebases for Android and iOS, managing versioning changes, and ensuring simultaneous updates. The need for offline access to downloadable books for both teachers and students further complicated the development process, as native development was inefficient in addressing these requirements.
Industry Domain
Professional Services
Service Category (Service-line)
Digital Platform/Product Engineering Services
Technologies Used
Flutter
Challenges
Maintaining separate codebases for Android and iOS.
Managing versioning and ensuring simultaneous updates across platforms.
Handling bug fixes and updates efficiently on multiple platforms.
How these challenges were overcome:
Choosing Flutter to develop a single codebase for both platforms.
Streamlining the maintenance and update process.
Leveraging Flutter’s capabilities to ensure high performance and a consistent user experience.
Solution Scope and Services
Approach taken: The Park Education app was developed using Flutter, enabling the creation of a unified codebase that supports both Android and iOS platforms.
Implementation details: By utilizing Flutter, the development team delivered an app that allows teachers and students to download and read books offline. The unified codebase facilitated quick problem-solving, streamlined maintenance, and ensured consistent updates across both platforms.
Technologies and tools used (tech stack):
Flutter SDK for cross-platform development
Dart programming language
Firebase for real-time database and analytics
PDF rendering libraries for offline book access
01
Flutter SDK
The core technology used for developing the Park Education app, allowing the team to build a single codebase that works seamlessly across multiple platforms. Flutter's rich set of pre-designed widgets and tools enabled the creation of a highly interactive and visually appealing user interface that could adapt to different screen sizes and resolutions.
02
Dart Programming Language
As the language behind Flutter, Dart was utilized to develop the app's core logic and functionalities. Its concise syntax and strong typing provided a solid foundation for building a reliable and maintainable codebase.
03
Firebase
Integrated to handle real-time database management and analytics, Firebase played a crucial role in ensuring that the app could provide instant feedback and data synchronization. This was particularly important for tracking student progress and enabling real-time interactions between users.
04
PDF Rendering Libraries
These were implemented to allow users to download and read books offline, a key feature of the Park Education app. By incorporating these libraries, the team ensured that students and teachers could access educational materials at any time, regardless of internet connectivity.
Results
Outcomes and benefits for the client:
Successful operation on both Android and iOS devices.
Uniform experience and high performance across different platforms.
Simplified maintenance and rapid delivery of updates.
Metrics or KPIs to show success:
30% reduction in development and maintenance costs.
25% faster deployment of updates.
Increased user satisfaction due to seamless offline access and consistent performance.
Summary of the project’s impact:
Utilizing Flutter for Park Education’s app development addressed the client’s challenges by providing a unified codebase, reducing development time, and ensuring consistent updates. This project highlights the efficiency and effectiveness of Flutter in delivering high-quality applications that meet diverse user needs, ultimately enhancing user satisfaction and operational efficiency for Park Education.

pages.content:
By
Sukriti Srivastava
/
A global safety information (data) provider to the Public Services sectors in 30 nations
Overview
The service provider achieved the development of a safety solution primarily aimed at mitigating security risks for women in public spaces, with our engineering solutions.
They sought our services to build out an application for to assess the safety of different areas within a city (urban safety) by crowdsourcing data on various safety parameters such as (for example) lighting, visibility, work areas/other hazards, crowds and public transport availability. This data is then overlaid with other data and used to generate safety scores and maps, safe zones and so on. This helps local governments, urban planners, and other stakeholders understand the on-ground issues and guides efforts to implement safety interventions based on the findings.
about the client
The company is a 10 plus year old information and data provider to Public Services (Govt. – Urban dev., Infrastructure, Transportation), NGOs, NFPs, Social organizations, and City corporations working in 75 Cities, 16 countries and with global multilateral bodies partners such as UN (World Bank, Development banks) and municipalities. As a social enterprise which provides a number of technology solutions targeted at making cities safer, especially for women, the company is headquarted in India.
Industry Domain
Professional Services (Information Services)
Service Category (Service-line)
Digital Platform/Product Engineering
Technologies Used
Php, MySQL
LAMP Framework
AWS Hosting
Android
Challenges
The client wanted to build a safety solution which uses apps to collect information and engage with individuals and uses these insights effectively in ensuring the safety of women. Data collected by the application is to be shared with governments, NGO’s, City planners, and other parties who wish to use this data to make a difference. To achieve this, the following was required to be addressed:
Vast Data Collection:  The company needed a solution capable of collecting extensive amounts of data from various sources.
Data Analysis and Segmentation:  The solution required the ability to analyse the collected data and classify it into meaningful, contextual segments.
Robust Portal:  The company needed a robust, reliable and high-performance portal to process large-scale data efficiently.
Regular Data Backups:  The solution had to include a mechanism for taking regular backups of all relevant information.
Report Generation:  The requirement of a portal that could generate concise reports based on the collected data, displayed on a full-scale map for each city and with clarity was very important.
Solution Scope and Services
After extensive consultations with the client, MDS developed an environment for auditors in the company to quickly have a complete overview of the data being collected along with providing the ability to upload images. This helped in codifying the cities.
MDS created a complete solution using an application stack which included MySQL, PHP, AWS and S3 technologies which were divided across several modules.
MDS analysts performed a thorough analysis of the project scope and decided on dividing the project into several modules to prevent the service from becoming cumbersome. While ensuring that these processes functioned well concurrently was a challenge, we chose technologies which would be capable of working together seamlessly.
01
Dashboard
A user-friendly interface was created to display information collected via several sources in a concise manner. This information could then be shared with several agencies with the right access to enable them to use it suitably.
02
Portal
Developed a robust and Intuitive portal which could process large volumes of data effectively and generate reports based on this collected data.
03
Android Application
Created an Android application which is to be installed on the end user’s smartphones. This application would show users their assigned routes and take pictures at regular intervals based on the vehicle’s speed.
04
Backend Development
We deployed several systems and technologies which would work concurrently to create a stable and scalable backend service on the LAMP stack.
Data captured using apps fitted in cars/taxis was seamlessly uploaded to S3 bucket servers. This was collated with the data captured from the portal and processed into meaningful data across various audit parameters.
PingDom, New Relic were integrated for server monitoring and ensuring uptime. Automated Backups were ensured with a seamless integration of Skeddly.
Results
Given that this was an extremely ambitious vision which required a multitude of applications and processes working together seamlessly to ensure the service runs perfectly which in turn ensured user safety , the project was satisfying experience for us and the customer.

pages.content:
By

Empowering early childhood intervention: MetaDesign Solutions develops a comprehensive digital platform to track and enhance child progress for a leading therapy provider
Overview
MetaDesign Solutions partnered with a leading therapy provider specializing in children with developmental challenges to develop a custom digital platform. The project included the development of a tablet application for iOS and Android, along with a web application to manage child progress, learning paths, and lesson schedules. Leveraging technologies like React, Node.js, and MongoDB Realm, the solution streamlined ABA therapy sessions, enabling real-time tracking and reporting for staff, teachers, and admins. The platform's comprehensive features provided a more efficient, effective way for the provider to serve children with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD), ensuring personalized learning and progress tracking for each child.
about the client
The client is a leading provider of Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) therapy services, focusing on early childhood intervention for children with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD). With centers based in Denver and Aurora, the company provides a joyful, inclusive environment where children can learn and develop essential skills for future success. Their mission is to offer science-based, individualized therapy services that are both highly effective and rooted in respect, care, and diversity.
As the company expanded, so did their need for a tailored digital solution. Previously, they relied on a third-party system to record and track child progress. However, the system lacked the comprehensive features needed to support their growing operations. To meet the evolving needs of their centers and ensure more effective management of therapy programs, they sought a more customizable and scalable solution, one that MetaDesign Solutions successfully developed.
Industry Domain
Allied Healthcare (Child Care and Development)
Service Category (Service-line)
Mobile App Development / Hybrid App Development / Digital Product Development / Web Application Development
Technologies Used
React Native
React
Node.js
Realm.io
AWS
MongoDB
Challenges
Customization Limitations: The third-party system did not offer the flexibility needed to tailor progress tracking and learning paths for individual children.
Scalability Issues: As the client’s centers grew, the existing system struggled to handle increased users and data, necessitating a more robust infrastructure.
Scheduling and Reporting: The manual effort required for lesson scheduling and progress reporting hindered operational efficiency and reduced time spent on direct therapy.
Data Security and Privacy: Ensuring the protection of sensitive data related to child progress and health while complying with industry standards and regulations was critical.
Cross-Platform Functionality: The need for both web and mobile platforms for different user roles (admin, staff, teacher) posed a technical challenge in ensuring a seamless, synchronized experience.
Solution Scope and Services
MetaDesign Solutions developed a comprehensive digital product suite consisting of a tablet application available on iOS and Android, as well as a web-based platform. These applications allow for the easy recording of child progress, the definition of individualized learning paths, and tracking through advanced scheduling and reporting tools. With distinct login personas for admin, staff, and teachers, the platform is designed to cater to each user's needs, making data access streamlined and secure.
Key to the backend architecture was the use of Node.js and MongoDB's Realm, a Backend-as-a-Service (BaaS) platform that enabled efficient data management and synchronization across devices. For hosting, AWS was selected to ensure scalability and high availability. Additionally, Selenium was employed for quality assurance, automating testing across different environments to ensure consistent performance across both web and mobile platforms.
01
Cross-Platform Development with React Native
Building both iOS and Android tablet applications using React Native enabled the creation of a seamless experience for users across platforms. With a single codebase, MetaDesign Solutions ensured that updates and maintenance could be done more efficiently, reducing development time and costs. The cross-platform functionality was crucial for the client, who required both Android and iOS access for their staff.

Leveraging MongoDB Realm for Backend Efficiency
MongoDB Realm was chosen for its ability to provide real-time data synchronization and handle complex datasets efficiently. The BaaS platform allowed the client to focus on their core business while benefiting from a reliable backend infrastructure. The use of Realm also enabled offline capabilities, allowing staff to track progress even when internet connectivity was unstable, ensuring no data was lost.
03
Ensuring Quality with Selenium Automation
To ensure the quality of the web and mobile applications, MetaDesign Solutions integrated Selenium for automated testing. This significantly reduced the time required for manual testing, particularly when scaling the platform across multiple devices and environments. Automation ensured that both the web and mobile apps maintained consistent performance, meeting high standards of reliability and user experience.

The digital platform developed by MetaDesign Solutions had a transformative effect on the client’s operations. By replacing the less flexible third-party system with a tailored solution, the client was able to optimize the management of therapy sessions, learning paths, and child progress tracking. The intuitive design and cross-platform functionality provided a seamless user experience across different devices, allowing staff to focus more on direct child interaction rather than administrative tasks.
Additionally, the robust backend built using Node.js and MongoDB Realm ensured that the platform was scalable and secure, capable of handling increasing volumes of data as the centers expanded. With advanced scheduling and reporting capabilities, the client saw a significant reduction in administrative overhead, enabling their team to focus on delivering high-quality therapy services to children. This project underscores MetaDesign Solutions' expertise in building custom, scalable digital platforms that address the unique needs of specialized industries like therapy and healthcare.

Overview
MetaDesign Solutions successfully developed a comprehensive digital platform for a global healthcare communications company. The platform, comprising a website and mobile app, offers cardiologists and healthcare professionals the latest news, expert insights, case studies, and educational resources in interventional cardiology. Utilizing a robust technology stack including ReactJS, Flutter SDK, PHP, AWS, and MySQL, the platform addresses critical challenges like user engagement, content management, scalability, and secure data processing, ultimately enhancing the global reach and impact of medical education.

Our customer is a leading global digital Continuing Medical Education (CME) services company based in India, specializing in healthcare communications. With a strong presence in the medical and pharmaceutical industries, our customer offers a diverse range of services including medical publishing, digital education, and knowledge processing. Their core mission is to support healthcare professionals by providing access to high-quality educational resources, enabling them to stay updated with the latest advancements in medicine. By collaborating with international medical societies and institutions, our customer ensures that their content meets global standards, thus enhancing the knowledge and skills of medical professionals.
Operating primarily in South Asia with a global reach, it has established itself as a trusted partner for healthcare professionals seeking to maintain their licenses and stay informed about new developments in their fields. Their commitment to improving the quality of healthcare delivery is reflected in their comprehensive communication solutions that cater to the ever-evolving needs of the medical community. Enhancing User Engagement and Interaction: Developing a platform that facilitates active user engagement through interactive features like polls, discussions, and expert presentations.
Streamlining Content Management: Creating a robust content management system (CMS) to handle a large volume of medical content while ensuring easy updates and distribution.
Ensuring Scalability and Performance: Designing the platform to handle high traffic from a global audience while maintaining optimal performance.

Solution Scope and Services
MetaDesign Solutions was tasked with creating a dynamic digital platform that would serve as a vital resource for cardiologists and healthcare professionals. The project scope involved developing a responsive website and a mobile app that offered a wide array of features including the latest news in cardiology, expert perspectives, case studies, and educational resources. Given the global reach of our customer, the platform needed to handle high traffic efficiently while providing a seamless user experience. To achieve this, MetaDesign Solutions leveraged AWS cloud infrastructure, implementing load balancers and containers to optimize costs and ensure reliable scaling. The secure processing of sensitive medical data was another critical aspect, requiring the development of robust security protocols to protect user information and maintain compliance with industry standards.

Developing Headless Custom CMS
Developing a custom CMS platform was crucial to support the unique feature set required by our customer's digital platform. The CMS needed to be flexible enough to support various content formats and provide easy API integration for the website and mobile app. MetaDesign Solutions successfully developed this CMS, enabling our customer to manage their content effortlessly while ensuring that it is readily accessible to healthcare professionals globally.

With a focus on sustainability and innovation, Signify offers a comprehensive range of lighting products, systems, and services that cater to diverse needs—from home lighting to commercial and industrial solutions. pages.content:
By
Pooja Makkar
/
Streamlining document creation with an indesign plugin integrated with Salesforce for efficient project and contract profile generation
Overview
MetaDesign Solutions partnered with The Hunley Group, a leading Salesforce consulting firm, to build an InDesign plugin integrated with Salesforce API. The goal was to streamline the creation of project profiles and contracts for real estate companies. By merging data from Salesforce with predefined InDesign templates, the plugin automates PDF generation, significantly reducing manual work. The solution has empowered The Hunley Group to offer enhanced document management capabilities to its real estate clients, driving productivity and operational efficiency.
about the client
The Hunley Group specializes in Salesforce consulting, helping companies across diverse industries, including construction and real estate, optimize their business processes using Salesforce. Their services range from Salesforce implementation, data migration, and managed services to strategic consulting and custom application development. The company’s expertise lies in integrating Salesforce with third-party platforms and creating industry-specific solutions, particularly for the real estate sector.
In this case, The Hunley Group aimed to improve document management for their real estate clients by leveraging Salesforce’s data capabilities in tandem with InDesign’s design tools. Specifically, their real estate customers required an efficient way to generate contract profiles and project summaries using data stored in Salesforce. This involved pulling content from multiple Salesforce tables and custom fields, merging it into pre-defined templates in InDesign, and uploading the final documents back into Salesforce for easy access and future reference.
Industry Domain
Banking, Financial Services and Insurance
Service Category (Service-line)
Adobe Plug-in Development / Salesforce Custom Development
Technologies Used
InDesign SDK
Salesforce API
Angular
Challenges
Salesforce Integration: Developing seamless connectivity between Salesforce and InDesign through the Salesforce API while managing data from multiple tables and custom fields.
Automated Data Merge: Using InDesign’s XML Merge functionality to automate the merging of Salesforce data into predefined templates.
Real-Time Uploads: Ensuring generated PDFs were successfully uploaded back into Salesforce without manual intervention.
User-Friendly Interface: Creating an intuitive UI within the InDesign plugin to allow users to view data blocks and easily merge them with InDesign templates.
Solution Scope and Services
MetaDesign Solutions built a custom plugin for InDesign that directly integrated with Salesforce via the Salesforce API. The solution fetched data from multiple Salesforce tables and custom fields, presenting it within a user-friendly interface inside InDesign. Users could then select relevant data blocks and merge them into pre-designed templates using InDesign’s built-in XML Merge functionality.
The plugin streamlined document creation by automating the merging process, allowing real estate clients to generate PDF profiles of contracts and projects efficiently. Once the documents were created, they were automatically uploaded back into Salesforce for future access, providing a seamless end-to-end document management solution.
01
Leveraging Salesforce API for Seamless Data Integration
The integration with Salesforce API enabled the plugin to fetch real-time data from various tables and custom fields, ensuring accuracy and up-to-date information in every generated document. This direct connection allowed for a smooth flow of data between platforms, removing the need for manual data entry.
02
Streamlining Document Creation with InDesign’s XML Merge
Utilizing the XML Merge feature in Adobe InDesign allowed the solution to automate the complex task of merging Salesforce data into templates. This reduced the time spent on document creation and ensured consistency across all project and contract profiles.
03
Enhancing Workflow with Real-Time PDF Uploads to Salesforce
The plugin’s ability to upload generated PDF documents back into Salesforce in real time removed the need for manual document handling, enhancing efficiency and maintaining an organized document repository for future use.
Results
The InDesign plugin developed by MetaDesign Solutions enabled The Hunley Group to enhance their real estate clients' document management systems. By automating the generation of project profiles and contracts directly within InDesign and integrating with Salesforce, the plugin drastically reduced manual work and improved productivity. The solution allowed users to quickly generate and upload documents back into Salesforce, simplifying document handling processes for the customer.
This innovative solution exemplifies how MetaDesign Solutions can blend Salesforce API integration with creative design tools to solve real-world business challenges, particularly for industry-specific needs.

The project scope involved the design and development of a mobile application tailored to meet Coca-Cola India’s specific needs for tracking and managing their network of refrigerated coolers in retail locations. The application allowed sales and distribution staff to monitor cooler locations, check inventory in real-time, and manage support tickets efficiently. It also enabled shop owners to report issues, request support, and upload pictures of the coolers, ensuring that maintenance needs were addressed promptly.
The backend, built on a cloud-hosted Laravel framework, provided a robust admin panel with multiple user personas, allowing admin users to manage coolers, assign them to specific users, send push notifications, and review cooler images. The solution addressed key challenges such as offline data synchronization, data security, and scalability, ensuring that the application could support a wide range of devices and scale horizontally to handle large volumes of data effectively.
01
Application Development
The application was developed using the Ionic Framework, which allowed MetaDesign Solutions to maintain a common codebase across various mobile devices, ensuring compatibility and performance across a broad spectrum of phones. Ionic's hybrid development capabilities enabled us to deliver a seamless user experience while reducing development time and costs. The framework's flexibility allowed for easy updates and maintenance, ensuring that the application could evolve with Coca-Cola’s needs.
02
Backend Development
The backend of the application was hosted on the cloud and developed using the Laravel PHP framework. This robust framework enabled the creation of a powerful admin panel and a web API for storing responses and managing data synchronization between the application and the backend servers. By leveraging cloud hosting, the solution ensured high availability, scalability, and secure data management, allowing Coca-Cola to manage their cooler operations effectively.
03
Horizontal Scalability and Data Security
Implementing horizontal scalability was crucial for handling the vast amount of data generated by Coca-Cola’s extensive network of coolers. Using AWS Cloud Services, we ensured that the application could scale efficiently to meet growing demands. Data security was another critical focus, with encryption and secure authentication mechanisms implemented to protect sensitive information and ensure compliance with industry standards. This combination of scalability and security allowed Coca-Cola to expand their operations without compromising on performance or data integrity.
Results
The mobile application developed by MetaDesign Solutions for Coca-Cola India has had a significant positive impact on the company’s operations. By providing real-time visibility into cooler locations and inventories, the application has streamlined Coca-Cola’s sales and distribution processes, enabling more efficient management of their extensive network of coolers. The ability to track coolers, manage maintenance requests, and ensure data security has enhanced operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.
The use of the Ionic Framework for mobile development, combined with a robust cloud-hosted backend using Laravel, ensured that the application was scalable, secure, and capable of supporting a wide range of devices. The successful implementation of this solution not only met Coca-Cola’s current needs but also positioned them for future growth and innovation. MetaDesign Solutions is proud to have contributed to Coca-Cola’s mission to refresh the world and make a positive difference in people’s lives through this advanced technological solution.

headings.text: Building a feature-rich news app for Samsung's Tizen OS using Angular and Tizen SDK, enabling Jagran’s vernacular news content for a new mobile OS platform, overcoming early-stage technology challenges

pages.content:
By
Pooja Makkar
/
Building a feature-rich news app for Samsung's Tizen OS using Angular and Tizen SDK, enabling Jagran’s vernacular news content for a new mobile OS platform, overcoming early-stage technology challenges
Overview
MetaDesign Solutions was enlisted as a vendor for Samsung to port the popular Jagran News App from Android and iOS to the new Tizen OS. Using Angular and Tizen SDK, the app was developed to integrate seamlessly with Jagran’s RSS feed and APIs, offering content to consumers on Samsung devices running Tizen OS. The project involved overcoming SDK limitations and lack of community support for the newly launched OS, ensuring a smooth user experience for Samsung customers accessing Jagran’s news content.
about the client
Samsung is a global leader in electronics and a key player in the mobile industry, with a vast range of devices spanning smartphones, tablets, and more. In their efforts to expand the Tizen OS as a viable alternative to Android and iOS, Samsung launched a campaign to attract popular applications for their app store. As part of this initiative, Samsung engaged MetaDesign Solutions to develop a Tizen-compatible version of the Jagran app, one of India’s most widely read vernacular newspapers.
Jagran is a leading North Indian media house known for its extensive coverage in Hindi and other regional languages, reaching millions of readers daily. Their digital platform is highly popular on Android and iOS devices, and Samsung sought to replicate this success on its newly launched Tizen OS. The goal was to bring Jagran’s rich content, delivered through RSS feeds and APIs, to Samsung’s Tizen-powered devices to attract more users to the platform.
Industry Domain
Technology, Media
Service Category (Service-line)
Mobile App Development / Tizen App Development
Technologies Used
Tizen SDK
Angular
RSS
Web API
Challenges
New Technology Platform: Tizen OS was a new entrant in the market, and its SDK was still evolving, offering limited documentation and support.
Integration Complexity: Integrating RSS feeds and APIs from Jagran's established infrastructure to work smoothly with the Tizen web-based SDK presented a unique challenge.
Optimizing Performance: The app had to be optimized for performance, ensuring smooth content delivery and display across various Samsung devices running Tizen.
No Community Support: Due to the early stage of Tizen's development, there was no established developer community or open-source resources to assist in solving challenges.
Solution Scope and Services
MetaDesign Solutions took on the task of developing a Tizen OS version of the Jagran app, which was initially available only on Android and iOS platforms. Using the Tizen SDK, which operates largely as a web development tool, the development team created a version of the app built on Angular. The primary objective was to replicate the core functionality of the Jagran app—displaying rich news content—while ensuring compatibility with Tizen’s architecture.
To meet this goal, we integrated the web interface with Jagran’s RSS feed, which fetched real-time news updates, and APIs provided by the Jagran team. These integrations were key to maintaining the app’s content relevance and delivering a seamless user experience. Despite the limitations and lack of community support for Tizen, MetaDesign Solutions successfully navigated these challenges by developing custom solutions and workarounds to ensure app functionality.
01
Cross-Platform Development Using Angular
By choosing Angular as the front-end framework, we ensured that the development process was efficient, enabling us to replicate key features from the Android and iOS versions. Angular’s flexibility allowed for the seamless integration of APIs and RSS feeds, ensuring that the content delivery experience mirrored that of other platforms.
02
Optimizing for Tizen SDK
The decision to use the Tizen SDK presented unique challenges, as it was still in its early stages. Our team worked through the limitations by developing custom solutions and leveraging in-house expertise to fill gaps left by the lack of community or documentation. This approach helped deliver a stable and smooth-running application for Tizen users.
03
Delivering High-Performance News Delivery
With real-time news being a key feature of the Jagran app, performance optimization was critical. Our team focused on ensuring that the integration of RSS feeds and APIs ran smoothly, offering users a fast, responsive interface to access up-to-date news content.
Results
The successful development of the Jagran app for Samsung's Tizen OS demonstrated MetaDesign Solutions' ability to work with emerging technologies and overcome the hurdles of a new platform. By leveraging Angular and Tizen SDK, we ensured that Samsung’s Tizen users had access to high-quality news content from Jagran, helping Samsung expand the appeal of its new OS. The application launch was a positive step towards growing the Tizen ecosystem, offering value to Samsung’s customers while extending Jagran’s digital footprint.

headings.text: Seamless AI-powered transformation of live video streams—real-time object detection and modification at broadcast scale, engineered by MetaDesign Solutions
Real-time Video Stream Processing at Scale
Optimized Object Detection using YOLO Models
Robust Deployment on On-Premise GPU Farm

pages.content:
By
Pooja Makkar
/
Seamless AI-powered transformation of live video streams—real-time object detection and modification at broadcast scale, engineered by MetaDesign Solutions
Overview
MetaDesign Solutions successfully developed a high-performance, AI-driven platform for a leading European television broadcasting and production company. The system is designed to process live video streams in real time, identify and blur selected objects with AI precision, and reconstruct the video output with virtually zero latency. Built for scale and reliability, the platform ensures uninterrupted streaming with intelligent failover and optimized GPU resource utilization.
about the client
The client is a prominent European media conglomerate known for producing world-renowned entertainment formats and operating multiple national TV channels and a proprietary OTT platform. With its headquarters in Europe, the company has a strong presence in the broadcast and digital media space, delivering thousands of hours of primetime content across several continents.
The company continues to expand its global footprint through strategic acquisitions and diversified ventures into the digital and sports domains. Known for its cutting-edge broadcasting standards and technology-driven media innovation, the client sought a solution that could enhance viewer privacy and regulatory compliance during live broadcasts without compromising stream quality or performance.
Industry Domain
Tech/Media
Service Category (Service-line)
AI/ML
OpenCV
Computer Vision
Video Processing
GPU
YOLO
Technologies Used
GPU
Python
AI/ML
YOLO
OpenCV
FFMPEG
Challenges
Developing an AI model capable of accurately detecting and identifying objects in real-time video streams
Ensuring negligible delay between the incoming and outgoing video feeds while applying modifications
Building a high-throughput pipeline to deconstruct and reconstruct video frames without losing quality or frames
Designing a failover mechanism to maintain an uninterrupted stream in case of system hiccups
Scaling the system to support multiple concurrent video streams while maintaining GPU efficiency
Solution Scope and Services
MetaDesign Solutions architected and delivered a robust AI-powered solution that takes live video as input, detects designated objects using custom-trained YOLO models, and applies real-time blurring through OpenCV-based transformations. The frame stream is then recompiled and rendered with imperceptible delay, maintaining the broadcast’s integrity.
The entire solution was built on a Python-powered stack and deployed over a dedicated on-premise GPU server farm to ensure optimal performance. Special focus was given to stream reliability, with a smart failover strategy and stream health monitoring integrated into the pipeline. This helped maintain a consistent viewing experience across all scenarios, even at scale.
01
Real-time Video Stream Processing at Scale
The platform was engineered to process and reconstruct high-frame-rate video streams in real time. Using Python and OpenCV, frame-by-frame manipulation was achieved with millisecond precision, enabling the broadcaster to edit content on the fly without any noticeable delay for the viewer.
02
Optimized Object Detection using YOLO Models
Leveraging the power of YOLO (You Only Look Once) object detection models, the AI pipeline achieved fast and accurate detection of pre-defined object categories. These models were custom-trained and optimized for performance on GPU hardware, ensuring real-time inference without frame drops.
03
Robust Deployment on On-Premise GPU Farm
By choosing on-premise GPU deployment, the solution gave the broadcaster full control over data and performance, avoiding latency and security concerns often associated with cloud. The GPU infrastructure was configured for scalability and high availability, making the platform production-grade from day one.
Results
The collaboration between MetaDesign Solutions and the client resulted in a cutting-edge, AI-enabled video processing platform that addressed a critical need in modern broadcasting—content compliance in real time. The developed system empowered the broadcaster to apply live edits without latency, ensuring both privacy and regulatory adherence.
Moreover, the use of on-premise GPU infrastructure provided a cost-effective and performant foundation, enabling the client to handle high-quality live broadcasts with full control over the compute environment. The system’s scalability and robustness now allow the client to confidently handle future broadcasting requirements, including international expansion and increased stream loads.
The innovative mobile app has streamlined data collection, enhanced user engagement, and provided real-time feedback, enabling athletes to focus on refining their technique. The successful implementation of this solution highlights MetaDesign Solutions’ expertise in IoT, mobile app development, and innovative product design, setting a benchmark for similar initiatives.

pages.content:
By
Sukriti Srivastava
/
Automating invoice processing and accounts payable with MetaDesign Solutions’ RPA expertise: a game-changer for a leading real estate firm
Overview
MetaDesign Solutions developed a highly efficient, automated accounts payable and invoice processing solution for a major U.S.-based real estate company. By leveraging UI Path, Python scripting, OCR, and ERP integrations, the automated workflow transformed the client's finance operations, resulting in reduced manual errors, expedited payment cycles, and improved cash flow management.
about the client
Our client, a leading real estate company in the U.S., manages an expansive portfolio of properties and collaborates with a large network of contractors. With properties ranging from small residential buildings to large commercial complexes, they handle a high volume of transactions daily. Efficient financial operations are essential to their business model, as they require timely processing of invoices and payments to maintain contractor relationships and optimize cash flow.
Facing challenges with time-consuming manual invoice processing, this client sought a digital transformation of their finance operations. They aimed to automate repetitive, error-prone tasks within their accounts payable department to improve productivity and minimize delays. With MetaDesign Solutions’ expertise in robotic process automation (RPA), they envisioned a future-proof, streamlined approach to their finance workflow.
Industry Domain
Banking, Financial Services and Insurance
Service Category (Service-line)
RPA, Business Process Automation
Technologies Used
UIPath
Python
OCR
Challenges
High Volume of Invoices : The client faced challenges managing an extensive volume of invoices, leading to delays and backlogs in the accounts payable process.
Manual Errors : The manual data entry process resulted in frequent errors, impacting both payment accuracy and vendor satisfaction.
Time-Consuming Validations : Cross-verifying invoices with purchase orders and reconciling data with ERP systems was both labor-intensive and prone to oversight.
Approval Delays : The client’s approval and escalation processes often slowed down payment cycles, impacting contractor relationships.
Integration with Existing ERP : Achieving seamless integration with the client’s existing ERP and financial systems required careful customization and testing.
Solution Scope and Services
MetaDesign Solutions implemented a custom-built RPA solution using UI Path, enhanced by Python scripting and OCR for accurate data extraction from invoices. Bots were deployed to automate end-to-end processes, including invoice receipt, data extraction, validation, and payment processing. By setting up workflow automation, our solution extracted data from PDF invoices, validated it against purchase orders, and updated the client's ERP system automatically.
The bots were also configured to handle approval workflows, flagging discrepancies for human review and ensuring consistent, real-time updates to the finance system. A Chrome extension was developed for easy access to the automation interface, simplifying user interactions. This comprehensive automation solution eliminated bottlenecks, reduced errors, and shortened payment cycles, significantly enhancing operational efficiency.
01
Leveraging OCR for Accurate Data Extraction
To automate invoice processing, OCR technology was integrated with RPA to handle diverse document formats. By automatically extracting key information from invoices, this technology reduced manual errors significantly and ensured that the system could handle a wide variety of invoice templates seamlessly.
02
Streamlined ERP Integration for Real-Time Financial Insights
Integrating the RPA bots with the client’s ERP system allowed data to flow automatically between systems, providing real-time updates and reducing the administrative burden on the finance team. This integration offered the client greater transparency into payment statuses and cash flow.
03
Optimizing Approval Workflow with Custom Chrome Extension
A custom Chrome extension was developed to provide users with a simplified, interactive interface for managing approvals and monitoring invoice processing. This allowed the finance team to access automation tools directly within their browser, enhancing user experience and ensuring swift approval cycles.
Results
The automated accounts payable and invoice processing solution developed by MetaDesign Solutions delivered transformative results for the client. By reducing the need for manual data entry and accelerating the entire payment process, the finance team achieved unprecedented levels of productivity and accuracy. The RPA-driven solution not only improved cash flow management but also strengthened vendor relationships by ensuring prompt, error-free payments.
The client benefited from reduced operational costs and gained real-time visibility into their financial processes, empowering them to make data-driven decisions with greater confidence. MetaDesign Solutions’ expertise in RPA and digital transformation has positioned the client for sustainable growth, equipped with a scalable, efficient finance solution capable of adapting to evolving business needs.

Seamlessly unifying diverse content repositories with secure, scalable, and real-time API solutions for global digital CME services
Overview
MetaDesign Solutions successfully developed a comprehensive backend solution for a leading global digital CME services company. The project involved creating a unified content delivery system by integrating multiple CMS repositories, ensuring secure and scalable API performance, and enabling real-time content updates through webhooks. This solution empowered the client to deliver educational content seamlessly across web and mobile platforms, enhancing their service offerings and operational efficiency.
about the client
The client is a digital content business (KPO) service, with its headquarters and operations in India, which operates across multiple cities globally. Their extensive portfolio includes services that cater to a diverse audience of healthcare professionals, offering them access to the latest medical knowledge and continuing education. The company’s commitment to quality and innovation has positioned them as a leader in the field of digital medical communications, supporting the ongoing education of healthcare providers in South Asia and beyond.
Their customer is a digital content business (to which they syndicate content), with its headquarters and operations in India. This company is sourcing content from our client.

Pharmaceuticals and Life Sciences
Service Category (Service-line)
Backend Development / CMS / API Development
Technologies Used
NODE.JS
MySQL
AWS
Sequelize ORM
REST
Challenges
Integration of Diverse CMS Repositories into a Unified Content Delivery System: The project required combining content from multiple CMS repositories, each with different data structures and technologies, into a single, cohesive data source.
Security and Authentication Management Across Multiple Platforms: Ensuring secure content delivery across various platforms, including web and mobile applications, was a critical challenge, necessitating advanced security measures.
Scalability and Performance Optimization for High Traffic Digital Products: The solution needed to support a high volume of users, requiring performance optimization techniques such as caching and parallel processing.
Real-time Content Synchronization and Update Notifications through Webhooks: The implementation of webhooks for real-time content updates posed a significant challenge, ensuring that the digital product was always up-to-date with the latest content.
Solution Scope and Services
MetaDesign Solutions undertook the challenge of developing a robust and scalable backend solution for the client’s digital content delivery needs. The project’s scope included engineering business rules and API-led delivery services, ensuring that content from multiple CMS repositories could be seamlessly integrated and delivered to end-users through web and mobile platforms. Our team also focused on security, implementing a Web Application Firewall (WAF) and federated user management to protect the integrity of the content and user data.
In addition to the core engineering tasks, the project also involved deploying the integration solution in a live production environment, with managed APIs and cloud services facilitating content delivery. The solution was designed to be scalable, allowing it to handle high traffic volumes and ensure optimal performance. Our DevOps team played a critical role in managing the content business service administration, operations, and CMS infrastructure, ensuring that the system remained reliable and efficient.
01
Developing Content API
Developing the content API involved addressing the challenge of integrating content from multiple repositories, each with different CMS structures and technologies. The solution required creating an orchestration layer that could standardize and serve content seamlessly to the digital product. This included building a flexible API that could handle varying data formats, ensuring that the content was delivered accurately and efficiently across all platforms.
02
API Performance
To ensure optimal API performance, we employed several techniques, including caching mechanisms and parallel search processes. These strategies were crucial in maintaining the speed and responsiveness of the API, particularly under high traffic conditions. By optimizing the data retrieval and processing methods, we were able to provide the digital product with fast and reliable access to the integrated content, enhancing the user experience.
03
Webhooks for Notification
The solution developed by MetaDesign Solutions had a significant positive impact on the client’s operations, enabling them to deliver educational content more efficiently and securely across multiple platforms. The integration of diverse CMS repositories into a unified content delivery system, combined with the implementation of advanced security measures and performance optimization techniques, resulted in a highly reliable and scalable solution. The use of webhooks for real-time updates further enhanced the client’s ability to provide up-to-date content to their users, solidifying their position as a leader in the global digital CME services industry.
Results
The positive impact of this solution is evident in the increased user interaction, improved content accessibility, and the platform’s ability to scale in response to growing demand. MetaDesign Solutions’ expertise in developing secure, scalable, robust and interactive APIs for digital platforms has enabled our client to fulfill its mission of supporting healthcare professionals worldwide through syndicated learning and education, ultimately contributing to the betterment of global healthcare standards.
This successful project not only met the client’s immediate needs but also laid the groundwork for future growth, allowing them to expand their digital offerings and reach a broader audience. The collaboration between MetaDesign Solutions and the client exemplifies the potential for innovative technology solutions to transform complex challenges into streamlined, effective operations.

The client is a business technology company specializing in advanced digital transformation solutions. They focus on helping businesses in regulated industries streamline operations and ensure compliance with industry-specific regulations. Their expertise lies in enterprise-level software solutions, such as ERP, CRM, and business intelligence systems, tailored for sectors like pharmaceuticals, chemicals, life sciences, and manufacturing.
To meet the evolving needs of their customers, the client offers a Software as a Service (SaaS) platform that integrates with Microsoft Dynamics 365, enabling businesses to optimize processes and ensure compliance with regulatory standards. Their platform supports complex operational requirements through specialized industry solutions, including integrated chemical management and quality management tools. However, they required a robust system for managing software licenses for their products across various industries, ensuring seamless license distribution, activation, and monitoring. MetaDesign Solutions was brought on board to deliver this functionality.
Industry Domain
Pharmaceuticals and Life Sciences
Service Category (Service-line)
No Code / Low Code Development
Technologies Used
CodeNula
NodeJS
ReactJS
PostgresQL
Challenges
License Lifecycle Management: The client needed an efficient system to handle the generation, allocation, and revocation of licenses for different customers and products.
Automated Workflow for Notifications: Building automated workflows for email notifications on specific license events such as activation, expiration, and renewals was a critical requirement.
Role-Based Access Control: A requirement for multiple user roles with specific permissions to manage products and licenses securely.
API Integration for Third-Party Tools: The system had to offer API support so third-party applications could generate and validate licenses, adding a layer of technical complexity.
Scalability and Cloud Hosting: The application had to be scalable and hosted in a cloud environment capable of handling future growth and user load.
Solution Scope and Services
MetaDesign Solutions developed a comprehensive license management platform using CodeNula, their in-house No Code tool. This web-based application allows the client to create, monitor, and manage software licenses for their SaaS products. A key feature of the system is the admin panel, which offers multi-role access, enabling users to manage products and licenses based on their privilege levels. The platform is highly flexible, allowing the client to allocate more licenses, revoke them when needed, and generate new ones through an easy-to-use interface.
The application also supports API integration, enabling third-party systems to interact with the license management tool for key functions like license generation, validation, and usage tracking. Built with a stack of ReactJS for the frontend, NodeJS for backend services, and PostgresQL for the database, the solution is hosted on AWS, ensuring scalability, security, and availability. MetaDesign also integrated workflows for automatic notifications to customers upon key events such as license activation, expiry, and renewals, helping streamline communication and user management.
01
API-Driven License Management for Seamless Integrations
The license management platform's API capabilities allowed the client to offer their SaaS products in an even more versatile manner. By supporting third-party applications, the client ensured that their customers could integrate the license generation, validation, and monitoring processes with their own systems, providing a smoother experience.
02
Scalability and Flexibility with AWS Cloud Hosting
Hosting the platform on AWS allowed the application to scale easily, meeting the growing demands of the client’s expanding customer base. AWS’s cloud infrastructure ensures high availability and performance while keeping the system secure, and provides the flexibility to handle varying workloads as the business grows.
03
Role-Based Access Control for Enhanced Security
The inclusion of a robust role-based access system ensured that users could only access features based on their privileges. This feature allows the client's administrators to assign different levels of access to their teams, maintaining security while enabling effective management of products and licenses.
Results
By leveraging MetaDesign Solutions’ expertise, the client successfully implemented a robust license management tool that integrates seamlessly into their existing SaaS offerings. The solution has enabled them to improve efficiency, automate key business workflows, and ensure that licenses are managed securely and accurately. Built with CodeNula and utilizing AWS Cloud for hosting, the platform can easily scale as the client's customer base grows, ensuring long-term reliability and performance. The addition of API support for third-party applications further enhances the platform's versatility, allowing for seamless integrations and enhanced customer experiences.
This project allowed the client to not only streamline their license management but also provided them with a flexible and scalable system for future growth.

headings.text: By implementing robust manual and automated quality assurance (QA) processes, MetaDesign Solutions ensured seamless, high-quality data integration for a leading Australian retail (Pharma and CPG) enterprise’s STIBO implementation
Efficient Test Data Management for Comprehensive Coverage

pages.content:
By
Pooja Makkar
/
By implementing robust manual and automated quality assurance (QA) processes, MetaDesign Solutions ensured seamless, high-quality data integration for a leading Australian retail (Pharma and CPG) enterprise’s STIBO implementation
Overview
MetaDesign Solutions partnered with a major retail enterprise in Australia to streamline quality assurance for their STIBO implementation. The project’s goal was to create a reliable, efficient testing framework that could support ongoing data management processes. MetaDesign Solutions' QA approach, combining manual and automated strategies, enabled the client to sustain rapid deployment cycles without sacrificing the quality or accuracy of critical business data.
about the client
Our client, a prominent retail enterprise in Australia, operates across various market segments, offering a vast product portfolio to consumers and vendors nationwide. In a dynamic retail market, they prioritize delivering accurate, high-quality product and service information to maintain customer satisfaction and operational efficiency. To this end, the client utilized the STIBO platform to centralize and streamline its master data management, thereby enabling consistent data distribution across various applications and geographic markets.
For this client, maintaining data accuracy was imperative. Their digital transformation objectives centered on integrating an agile, scalable quality assurance framework to support their ongoing application builds, version releases, and data updates. To address the need for rapid and frequent regression testing, the client sought an advanced QA solution that could accommodate evolving requirements while minimizing manual efforts. MetaDesign Solutions delivered this by developing a sustainable QA approach through automation, enabling efficiency without compromising on accuracy.
Industry Domain
Pharmaceuticals and Life Sciences
Service Category (Service-line)
Enterprise – QA Automation, Data Management/Engg.
Technologies Used
STIBO
Selenium
QA
Challenges
Frequent Application Builds and Testing Cycles: Continuous application updates left limited time for thorough testing between builds.
Resource-Intensive Manual Testing: Manual testing of old features was time-consuming and resource-intensive, impacting the deployment cycle.
Regression Testing Demands: Regression testing needed to be conducted early and frequently within agile sprints, challenging manual testing capabilities.
Requirement Flexibility in Agile Environments: Regular requirements changes required rapid test adaptability, demanding a highly flexible and responsive QA framework.
High Ongoing Costs of Manual Testing: Manual testing represented a significant ongoing cost due to high manpower requirements.
Solution Scope and Services
MetaDesign Solutions addressed these challenges by implementing a comprehensive manual and automated QA framework tailored to the client’s specific STIBO implementation needs. The solution scope included establishing an automation testing environment with best practices for folder structure, data identification, and test suite preparation. By automating the regression test cases, the project reduced the reliance on manual testing, achieving faster test cycles, improved accuracy, and a scalable QA framework that aligned with agile development practices.
We validated several core workflows, including BMI maintenance, store and service maintenance, site visit approvals, and file validation for various international markets. User roles, attribute validation, and reporting accuracy were further tested to ensure that the automation suite remained robust and adaptable to new updates. MetaDesign Solutions provided live demos to stakeholders, enabling transparency and alignment before final approval of the test suite. Automation was phased, with significant progress achieved in monthly milestones (20% in the first month and 45% in the second month), resulting in a QA framework poised for consistent improvements and faster test cycles.
01
Automation for Agile Testing Needs
MetaDesign Solutions integrated automated regression testing to support the client's agile development model. This enabled quicker testing cycles, reduced manual labor, and facilitated continuous testing alongside iterative updates, enhancing the team's overall efficiency and alignment with agile methodologies.
02
Efficient Test Data Management for Comprehensive Coverage
Ensuring accurate and reliable test data is critical in any QA process. The solution involved strategic test data identification and management, covering all regression test scenarios across multiple markets, allowing the client to maintain high data quality standards across diverse product categories.
03
Continuous Improvement in QA Processes
MetaDesign Solutions established an incremental automation plan, aiming for progressive increases in test automation coverage each month. This phased approach allowed the team to refine and expand automation efforts efficiently, achieving a balance between immediate testing needs and long-term scalability.
Results
MetaDesign Solutions' comprehensive approach to quality assurance brought lasting benefits to the client’s STIBO integration, ensuring efficient data validation and effective regression testing in a scalable environment. By automating critical QA processes, the client could allocate fewer resources to manual testing while achieving faster testing cycles and minimizing errors. The implemented solution supported agile methodologies, enabling the client to adapt quickly to requirement changes without adding to the testing burden.
As a result, the client realized reduced time-to-market for new features and updates, freeing resources for further innovation. MetaDesign Solutions' ability to deliver an adaptable, cost-effective QA framework underpinned the client’s objectives for seamless, high-quality data integration, proving instrumental to their continued digital transformation in the competitive retail sector.

MetaDesign Solutions and Ayana Solutions Forge Strategic Partnership to Drive Innovation in the Automotive Sector
Date: 06th November 2024, Gurugram India
MetaDesign Solutions is excited to announce a strategic partnership with Ayana Solutions to accelerate innovation in the automotive industry. This collaboration will focus on delivering advanced AI and machine learning solutions designed to elevate the next generation of automotive RFQs (Request for Quotations). With this partnership, both companies are poised to bring groundbreaking advancements that cater to the evolving needs of the automotive sector.
The partnership has already gained momentum with a productive initial meeting held with a prominent automotive Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM). During the discussion, MetaDesign Solutions and Ayana Solutions showcased their combined expertise and outlined innovative software solutions that promise to reshape the future of automotive engineering. The joint solutions are set to enhance the precision, efficiency, and scalability of automotive RFQs, driving a new wave of transformation within the sector.
MetaDesign Solutions and Ayana Solutions share a commitment to leveraging cutting-edge technology to meet the challenges and opportunities in automotive design and manufacturing. By harnessing the power of AI and ML, the partnership aims to streamline RFQ processes, reducing lead times, and enabling automotive manufacturers to bring new ideas to market faster.
“We’re thrilled about the endless possibilities this partnership unlocks. Together with Ayana Solutions, we’re not just imagining the future of automotive engineering; we’re building it,” said Amit Gupta, Director (RnD, Delivery, Sales) at MetaDesign Solutions.
This collaboration represents a significant step forward in the automotive industry, and both companies look forward to sharing more as they continue on this transformative journey.
For more information, please contact
sales@metadesignsolutions.com
Stay tuned as MetaDesign Solutions and Ayana Solutions lead the way in reshaping automotive innovation.
